rows.source_ko: 국방부 (조직관리담당관), 02-748-6572
rows.text_en: Ministry of National Defense ( Organization Management Officer ), 02-748-6572

rows.source_ko: 제1장 총칙
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 국방부와 그 소속기관에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원, 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 실장ㆍ국장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「국방부와 그 소속기관 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to define matters delegated by the “Organization of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing levels for auxiliary and advisory agencies established in the Ministry of National Defense and its affiliated agencies, the establishment and division of duties of auxiliary agencies and equivalent advisory agencies placed under directors and bureau chiefs pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act.”

rows.source_ko: 제2장 국방부
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Ministry of National Defense

rows.source_ko: 제1조의2(차관보) 차관보는 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Assistant Minister) The Assistant Minister shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.
[This Article Newly Inserted Jan. 2, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(국방보좌관) ① 국방보좌관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (National Defense Advisor) ① The National Defense Advisor shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position is Grade B. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 국방보좌관 밑에 정책관리담당관 및 의전담당관 각 1명을 두되, 정책관리담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 4급 상당 별정직공무원으로, 의전담당관은 영관급장교로 보한다. <개정 2009. 5. 26., 2010. 12. 31., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② One Policy Management Officer and one Protocol Officer shall be appointed under the National Defense Advisor; the Policy Management Officer shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or special service officials equivalent to Grade 4, and the Protocol Officer shall be appointed from among field-grade officers. <Amended May 26, 2009; December 31, 2010; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 정책관리담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 국방보좌관을 보좌한다. <개정 2009. 5. 26., 2026. 1. 2., 2026. 8. 14.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Policy Management Officer assists the National Defense Advisor with respect to the following matters. <Amended May 26, 2009; Jan. 2, 2026; Aug. 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 군사ㆍ과학분야 자료수집 및 업무보좌
rows.text_en: 1. Data collection and administrative support in the military and science fields

rows.source_ko: 2. 대통령ㆍ국무총리 및 장관의 지시사항에 관한 종합 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Comprehensive management of instructions from the President, Prime Minister, and Ministers

rows.source_ko: 3. 장관 보고자료에 대한 검토 보고
rows.text_en: 3. Review Report on the Minister's Report Materials

rows.source_ko: 4. 공보분야 업무보좌 및 연설ㆍ훈시자료의 작성 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Assisting with public information duties and drafting materials for speeches and instructions

rows.source_ko: 5. 장관 지휘기록집 작성 및 관련 자료 유지
rows.text_en: 5. Preparation of the Minister's Command Records and Maintenance of Related Materials

rows.source_ko: 6. 회의 및 순시ㆍ방문 등 장관의 지휘활동에 필요한 관련 자료 준비 및 일정 기획
rows.text_en: 6. Preparation of relevant materials and planning of schedules necessary for the Minister's command activities, such as meetings, inspections, and visits.

rows.source_ko: 7. 국방정책 관련 정보의 수집ㆍ분석ㆍ전파 및 공유
rows.text_en: 7. Collection, analysis, dissemination, and sharing of information related to national defense policy

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방정책 발전의제 발굴ㆍ조정ㆍ건의 및 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Identification, coordination, recommendation, and management of defense policy development agendas

rows.source_ko: 9. 국방현안 논의를 위한 의제의 작성, 회의록 준비 및 회의결과의 정리ㆍ전파
rows.text_en: 9. Preparation of agendas for the discussion of pending defense issues, preparation of meeting minutes, and organization and dissemination of meeting results

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 장관실의 행정지원 업무
rows.text_en: 10. Other administrative support duties of the Minister's Office

rows.source_ko: ④ 의전담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 국방보좌관을 보좌한다. <개정 2009. 5. 26., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Protocol Officer assists the National Defense Advisor with respect to the following matters. <Amended May 26, 2009; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 장관의 국외업무 보좌
rows.text_en: 1. Assisting the Minister with overseas affairs

rows.source_ko: 2. 장관 활동계획의 보좌 및 안전관리 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Assistance with the Minister's activity plan and safety management duties
3. Deleted <May 26, 2009>

rows.source_ko: 4. 대내ㆍ외 일정계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and coordination of internal and external schedules

rows.source_ko: 5. 국방부의 의식행사 및 의전에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning ceremonial events and protocol of the Ministry of National Defense

rows.source_ko: 6. 국방부를 방문하는 내ㆍ외빈의 안내에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Duties regarding the guidance of domestic and foreign guests visiting the Ministry of National Defense

rows.source_ko: 7. 국방부 각종회의의 의전에 관한 협조ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 7. Cooperation and support regarding protocol for various meetings of the Ministry of National Defense

rows.source_ko: 8. 정부행사의 군 의전인력 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the support of military protocol personnel for government events

rows.source_ko: 9. 국방관계 요인의 초청에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the invitation of defense-related officials

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 의전업무의 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Other matters concerning support for protocol duties
[Title amended Jan. 2, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(대변인) ① 대변인은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 별정직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Spokesperson) ① The Spokesperson shall be appointed as a general or special service public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position is Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ② 대변인 밑에 공보담당관ㆍ정책홍보담당관 및 디지털소통팀장 각 1명을 두되, 공보담당관은 영관급장교로, 정책홍보담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 디지털소통팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ임업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ환경사무관ㆍ항공사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 사서사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2009. 5. 26., 2010. 12. 31., 2019. 5. 7., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② One Public Information Officer, one Policy Promotion Officer, and one Digital Communication Team Leader shall be appointed under the Spokesperson; the Public Information Officer shall be a field-grade officer; the Policy Promotion Officer shall be a Deputy Director, a Science and Technology Secretary, or a Secretary; and the Digital Communication Team Leader shall be a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Forestry Officer, Health Officer, Environmental Officer, Aviation Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, Administrative Officer, or Library Officer. <Amended May 26, 2009; December 31, 2010; May 7, 2019; August 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 공보담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 대변인을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Public Affairs Officer assists the Spokesperson in the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방 관련 보도정책의 수립ㆍ조정 및 통제
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, coordination, and control of defense-related press policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방정책과 현안의 보도 및 내ㆍ외신 보도에 대한 분석ㆍ대응
rows.text_en: 2. Analysis and Response to Reports on Defense Policy and Current Issues, as well as Domestic and Foreign Media Coverage

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방정책과 현안의 공보계획의 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and Implementation of Public Information Plans for National Defense Policy and Current Issues

rows.source_ko: 4. 국방정책 관련 각종 정보 및 상황 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of various information and situations related to defense policy

rows.source_ko: 5. 내ㆍ외신 기자의 취재 지원 및 협조
rows.text_en: 5. Support and cooperation for domestic and foreign reporters' coverage

rows.source_ko: 6. 부내 업무의 대외 정책발표사항 관리 및 브리핑 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the management of external policy announcements regarding internal affairs and support for briefings

rows.source_ko: 7. 전자브리핑 운영 및 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the operation and support of electronic briefings

rows.source_ko: ④ 정책홍보담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 대변인을 보좌한다. <신설 2009. 5. 26., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Policy and Public Relations Officer assists the Spokesperson in the following matters. <Newly added May 26, 2009; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 주요 국방정책 홍보의 기획 및 전략 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Planning and Strategy Formulation for the Promotion of Major Defense Policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 주요 국방정책의 대내ㆍ외 홍보계획 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and implementation of domestic and international public relations plans for major defense policies

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방정책 홍보에 대한 평가계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and implementation of an evaluation plan for defense policy promotion

rows.source_ko: 4. 대외 홍보물의 제작지원 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Production support for external promotional materials

rows.source_ko: 5. 정책고객관리서비스(PCRM) 등 홍보콘텐츠 개발
rows.text_en: 5. Development of promotional content such as Policy Customer Relationship Management (PCRM)

rows.source_ko: 6. 군 위성텔레비전 방송 등 국방 홍보매체의 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 6. Coordination and control of national defense public relations media, such as military satellite television broadcasting
7. Deleted <July 21, 2010>

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방홍보원 업무의 운영 지원
rows.text_en: 8. Operational support for the Ministry of National Defense Public Relations Agency

rows.source_ko: 9. 정책홍보협의회의 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of the Policy Promotion Council

rows.source_ko: 10. 국방부 인터넷 홈페이지 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 10. Operation and Management of the Ministry of National Defense Internet Homepage

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 디지털소통팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 대변인을 보좌한다. <신설 2019. 5. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Digital Communication Team assists the Spokesperson with respect to the following matters. <Newly added May 7, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 주요 정책에 관한 디지털소통 계획의 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of digital communication plans regarding major policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 디지털소통 콘텐츠 제작 및 홍보
rows.text_en: 2. Production and promotion of digital communication content

rows.source_ko: 3. 디지털 채널을 통한 주요 정책의 대국민 홍보
rows.text_en: 3. Public promotion of major policies through digital channels

rows.source_ko: 제4조(장관정책보좌관) 장관정책보좌관 중 1명은 고위공무원단에 속하는 별정직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. 다만, 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 대체하여 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Ministerial Policy Advisor) One of the Ministerial Policy Advisors shall be appointed as a special-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. However, if the position is replaced by a general-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.
[Wholly Amended Dec. 12, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의2(기획조정실장) ① 기획조정실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4-2 (Director of Planning and Coordination Office) ① The Director of Planning and Coordination Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「국방부와 그 소속기관 직제」제7조의2제1항에 따라 기획조정실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 기획관리관ㆍ계획예산관 및 국방개혁기획관으로 하며, 기획관리관 및 계획예산관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 하고, 국방개혁기획관은 장성급장교로 보한다. <개정 2017. 10. 18., 2019. 12. 31., 2021. 3. 30., 2022. 7. 15., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 7-2, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office shall be the Director General for Planning and Management, the Director General for Planning and Budget, and the Director General for Defense Reform Planning. The Director General for Planning and Management and the Director General for Planning and Budget shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, with the job grade of their positions being Grade B, while the Director General for Defense Reform Planning shall be appointed as a general officer. <Amended Oct. 18, 2017; Dec. 31, 2019; Mar. 30, 2021; July 15, 2022; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 기획관리관은 「국방부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제7조의2제3항제1호부터 제21호까지, 제25호 및 제26호의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2025. 5. 20.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General of Planning and Management assists the Director General with respect to matters under Article 7-2, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 1 through 21, 25, and 26 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Amended May 20, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 계획예산관은 「국방부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제7조의2제3항제22호부터 제24호까지 및 제27호부터 제31호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2025. 5. 20.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Planning and Budget Officer assists the Director with respect to matters under Subparagraphs 22 through 24 and 27 through 31 of Article 7-2, Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Amended May 20, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 국방개혁기획관은「국방부와 그 소속기관 직제」제7조의2제3항제32호부터 제37호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2021. 3. 30., 2021. 12. 14., 2022. 7. 15., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director General for Defense Reform Planning assists the Director General with respect to matters under Subparagraphs 32 through 37 of Article 7-2, Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Newly added Mar. 30, 2021; Dec. 14, 2021; July 15, 2022; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 기획조정실장 밑에 기획총괄담당관ㆍ국군조직담당관ㆍ조직관리담당관ㆍ혁신행정담당관ㆍ재정계획담당관ㆍ예산편성담당관ㆍ예산운영담당관ㆍ재정회계담당관ㆍ군구조개혁담당관 및 국방운영개혁담당관 각 1명을 두며, 기획총괄담당관ㆍ국군조직담당관ㆍ조직관리담당관ㆍ혁신행정담당관ㆍ재정계획담당관ㆍ예산편성담당관ㆍ예산운영담당관 및 재정회계담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 군구조개혁담당관 및 국방운영개혁담당관은 영관급장교로 보한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Under the Director of Planning and Coordination, there shall be one Director General for Planning and Coordination, Director General for Armed Forces Organization, Director General for Organization Management, Director General for Innovation and Administration, Director General for Financial Planning, Director General for Budget Formulation, Director General for Budget Operations, Director General for Financial Accounting, Director General for Military Structure Reform, and Director General for National Defense Operations Reform; the Director General for Planning and Coordination, Director General for Armed Forces Organization, Director General for Organization Management, Director General for Innovation and Administration, Director General for Financial Planning, Director General for Budget Formulation, Director General for Budget Operations, and Director General for Financial Accounting shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretaries, or Secretaries, while the Director General for Military Structure Reform and the Director General for National Defense Operations Reform shall be appointed as Field-grade officers. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 기획총괄담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2018. 5. 25., 2019. 5. 7., 2021. 3. 30., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Director General of Planning and Coordination assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters. <Amended May 25, 2018; May 7, 2019; March 30, 2021; January 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방기획에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 1. Duties related to defense planning

rows.source_ko: 2. 국정운영 및 시책 관련 업무의 종합 및 조정

rows.text_en: 4. Operation of the government contract system in the defense sector, and handling of inquiries and responses regarding accounting

rows.text_en: 7. Operation and Development of the Integrated Defense Financial Information System

rows.text_en: 8. Management of linkage with the resource management system

rows.source_ko: 9. 재무결산 및 분석

rows.text_en: 10. Guidance and Supervision of Operations of the Armed Forces Financial Management Agency

rows.source_ko: ⑮ 군구조개혁담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: 15. The Officer in Charge of Military Structure Reform assists the Director of the Planning and Coordination Office with respect to the following matters. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방개혁 정책의 총괄ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of defense reform policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방개혁기본계획의 수립ㆍ변경
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and Amendment of the Basic Plan for National Defense Reform

rows.source_ko: 3. 5년 단위 국방개혁추진계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and implementation of a five-year national defense reform plan

rows.text_en: 4. Comprehensive review of the annual implementation plans of each implementing agency and department for defense reform

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방개혁위원회 운영

rows.source_ko: 9. 군구조 분야 개혁정책의 조정
rows.text_en: 9. Coordination of reform policies in the military structure sector

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 실 내 다른 담당관의 주관에 속하지 않는 국방개혁 관련 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Other matters related to defense reform that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other officials within the office

rows.source_ko: ⑯ 국방운영개혁담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: 16. The Officer in Charge of Defense Operations Reform assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방운영ㆍ병영문화 분야 개혁정책의 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Coordination of reform policies in the fields of defense operations and military culture

rows.source_ko: 2. 5년 단위 국방운영ㆍ병영문화 분야 개혁추진계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and implementation of five-year reform plans in the fields of national defense operations and military barracks culture

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방운영ㆍ병영문화 분야 개혁 각 시행기관ㆍ부서의 연도별 시행계획의 종합
rows.text_en: 3. Comprehensive review of annual implementation plans by each implementing agency and department for reforms in the fields of defense operations and military barracks culture

rows.source_ko: 4. 국방운영ㆍ병영문화 분야 국방개혁 과제의 추진실적 분석ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 4. Analysis and Evaluation of Implementation Performance of Defense Reform Tasks in the Fields of Defense Operations and Barracks Culture

rows.source_ko: 5. 미래국방전략위원회 운영 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Support for the operation of the Future National Defense Strategy Committee

rows.source_ko: 6. 국방개혁 관련 자문위원회 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Operation of the Advisory Committee on Defense Reform

rows.source_ko: 7. 국방개혁 관련 대내외 교육과정 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of internal and external training courses related to defense reform

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방개혁 관련 연구용역 및 세미나 기획ㆍ추진ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 8. Planning, implementation, and management of research projects and seminars related to defense reform
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 23, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(법무관리관) ① 법무관리관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Director General of Legal Affairs) ① The Director General of Legal Affairs shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position is Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ② 법무관리관 밑에 군사법정책담당관ㆍ규제개혁법제담당관 및 송무소청팀장 각 1명을 두며, 군사법정책담당관은 영관급장교로, 규제개혁법제담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 송무소청팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ임업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ환경사무관ㆍ항공사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 사서사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2010. 12. 31., 2022. 2. 22., 2023. 4. 18., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Under the Director General of Legal Affairs, one Military Justice Policy Officer, one Regulatory Reform and Legislation Officer, and one Litigation and Appeals Team Leader shall be appointed; the Military Justice Policy Officer shall be a field-grade officer; the Regulatory Reform and Legislation Officer shall be a Deputy Director General, a Science and Technology Secretary, or a Secretary; and the Litigation and Appeals Team Leader shall be a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Forestry Officer, Health Officer, Environmental Officer, Aviation Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, Administrative Officer, or Library Officer. <Amended Dec. 31, 2010; Feb. 22, 2022; Apr. 18, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023>

③ The Officer in Charge of Military Justice Policy assists the Director General of Legal Affairs with respect to the following matters. <Amended Nov. 10, 2014; Feb. 28, 2017; Nov. 21, 2017; Oct. 21, 2020; Jul. 15, 2022; Apr. 18, 2023; Oct. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법무정책에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning legal policy

rows.source_ko: 2. 군 사법제도에 관한 계획 및 그 시행의 감독
rows.text_en: 2. Planning regarding the military judicial system and supervision of its implementation

rows.source_ko: 3. 군 사법제도 개선 및 연구발전
rows.text_en: 3. Improvement and Research and Development of the Military Judicial System

rows.source_ko: 4. 군법무관의 임용ㆍ교육 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the appointment, training, etc. of military legal officers

rows.source_ko: 5. 군사법원의 설치ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of military courts

rows.source_ko: 6. 군 수사기관, 군 검찰기관 및 군 교도소에 대한 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 6. Guidance and Supervision of Military Investigative Agencies, Military Prosecution Agencies, and Military Prisons

rows.source_ko: 7. 형의 집행ㆍ사면ㆍ감형ㆍ복권 및 가석방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the execution of sentences, pardons, commutations, restoration of rights, and parole

rows.source_ko: 8. 군 보안관찰처분 및 군 사회보호처분에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning military security surveillance and military social protection dispositions

rows.source_ko: 9. 군 사법 관련 대국회업무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning affairs with the National Assembly regarding military justice

rows.source_ko: 10. 일반사법 기관 및 공소청ㆍ수사기관과의 협조
rows.text_en: 10. Cooperation with general judicial agencies and prosecution and investigative agencies

rows.source_ko: 11. 군 관련 법령의 교육에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 11. Duties regarding education on military-related laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: 12. 행정심판 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 12. Administrative Appeals Related Matters

rows.source_ko: 13. 군인ㆍ군무원의 징계 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 13. Disciplinary Affairs for Soldiers and Civilian Employees

rows.source_ko: 14. 배상심의와 관련된 업무
rows.text_en: 14. Matters related to compensation deliberation

rows.source_ko: 15. 군사법원 및 국방부검찰단 업무의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 15. Guidance and supervision of the affairs of military courts and the Ministry of National Defense Prosecutor's Office

rows.source_ko: 16. 각종 법률상담 및 법률구조 활동
rows.text_en: 16. Various legal counseling and legal aid activities

rows.source_ko: 17. 그 밖에 관내 다른 담당관의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 17. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other officials within the jurisdiction

④ The Officer in Charge of Regulatory Reform and Legislation assists the Director General of Legal Affairs with respect to the following matters. <Amended Nov. 10, 2014; Nov. 21, 2017; Feb. 22, 2022; Apr. 18, 2023; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법령안 및 훈령ㆍ예규안의 기초ㆍ심사
rows.text_en: 1. Drafting and Examination of Draft Laws, Directives, and Circulars

rows.source_ko: 2. 외국과의 군사 협정ㆍ협약 또는 국제계약에 관한 법적 검토, 해석 및 지원
rows.text_en: 2. Legal review, interpretation, and support regarding military agreements, conventions, or international contracts with foreign countries

rows.source_ko: 3. 주한미군지위협정(SOFA) 및 정전협정 관련 법적 검토
rows.text_en: 3. Legal Review of the Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA) and the Armistice Agreement

rows.source_ko: 4. 작전ㆍ환경ㆍ해양ㆍ항공 등에 관한 국제법 및 국제 사법에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning international law and international private law regarding operations, environment, maritime, aviation, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 국제협정ㆍ계약 및 계약분쟁에 관한 지원 업무
rows.text_en: 5. Support services regarding international agreements, contracts, and contract disputes

rows.source_ko: 6. 국방관계 외국법령의 수집ㆍ연구ㆍ편찬 및 발간 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Collection, research, compilation, and publication of foreign laws and regulations related to national defense

rows.source_ko: 7. 국방관계 법령의 입법계획 종합ㆍ조정 등 법령정비에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the revision of laws and regulations, such as the comprehensive coordination of legislative plans for defense-related laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방관계 법령집 및 전시관계 법령집의 발간 업무
rows.text_en: 8. Publication of National Defense-Related Laws and Wartime-Related Laws

rows.source_ko: 9. 국무회의 안건 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 9. Matters related to Cabinet meeting agendas

rows.source_ko: 10. 부내 규제개혁 및 정비에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning regulatory reform and streamlining within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 11. 국방부 소관 법령에 관한 자문 및 해석
rows.text_en: 11. Consultation and Interpretation of Laws and Regulations under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of National Defense

rows.source_ko: 13. 국방부장관이 행한 행정처분의 재심사제도 운영
rows.text_en: 13. Operation of the Re-examination System for Administrative Dispositions Taken by the Minister of National Defense

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 송무소청팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 법무관리관을 보좌한다. <신설 2023. 4. 18.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Litigation and Appeals Team assists the Director General of Legal Affairs with respect to the following matters. <Newly added Apr. 18, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방부 송무정책의 수립 및 소송 분석
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of Ministry of National Defense Litigation Policy and Analysis of Litigation

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방부 소송업무의 지휘ㆍ감독 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Command, supervision, overall management, and coordination of the Ministry of National Defense's litigation affairs

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방부 국가ㆍ행정소송의 수행 및 신청 사건 처리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 3. Duties concerning the conduct of state and administrative litigation and the processing of application cases by the Ministry of National Defense

rows.source_ko: 4. 국방부 헌법재판에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Ministry of National Defense’s duties regarding constitutional adjudication

rows.source_ko: 5. 군인ㆍ군무원의 소청에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning appeals by soldiers and civilian military employees

rows.source_ko: 6. 부정당업자 제재 등 국방부 계약심의회 운영에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the operation of the Ministry of National Defense Contract Review Committee, including sanctions against dishonest contractors

rows.source_ko: 제6조(감사관) ① 감사관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Auditor) ① The Auditor shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position is Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ② 감사관 밑에 감사총괄담당관ㆍ감사1담당관ㆍ감사2담당관 및 국방민원센터장 각 1명을 두되, 감사총괄담당관ㆍ감사1담당관ㆍ감사2담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보하며, 국방민원센터장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ임업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ환경사무관ㆍ항공사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 사서사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2017. 2. 28., 2023. 4. 18., 2023. 8. 30., 2026. 10. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② One Audit General Manager, one Audit 1 Manager, one Audit 2 Manager, and one Head of the National Defense Civil Affairs Center shall be appointed under the Auditor; provided that the Audit General Manager, Audit 1 Manager, and Audit 2 Manager shall be appointed as Deputy Director General, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary, and the Head of the National Defense Civil Affairs Center shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Forestry Officer, Health Officer, Environmental Officer, Aviation Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, Administrative Officer, or Library Officer. <Amended Feb. 28, 2017; Apr. 18, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023; Oct. 2, 2026>
③ The Chief Audit Officer assists the Auditor in the following matters. <Amended May 26, 2009; March 23, 2013; November 10, 2014; January 6, 2016; February 28, 2017; October 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방감사제도의 연구ㆍ발전
rows.text_en: 1. Research and Development of the Defense Audit System

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방부자체감사 운영지침의 수립ㆍ배포
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and Distribution of Operational Guidelines for Internal Audits of the Ministry of National Defense

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방부 자체감사계획의 종합 수립ㆍ조정 및 통제
rows.text_en: 3. Comprehensive establishment, coordination, and control of the Ministry of National Defense's internal audit plan

rows.source_ko: 3의2. 국방부와 그 소속기관 및 산하기관ㆍ단체, 국군 부대ㆍ기관에 대한 자체복무감사 계획수립 및 실시
rows.text_en: 3-2. Establishment and implementation of internal service audits for the Ministry of National Defense, its affiliated agencies, subordinate agencies and organizations, and ROK Armed Forces units and agencies

rows.source_ko: 3의3. 국방부와 그 소속기관 및 산하기관ㆍ단체, 국군 부대ㆍ기관에 대한 하명ㆍ이첩ㆍ민원 등 관련 복무감사 계획수립 및 실시
rows.text_en: 3-3. Establishment and implementation of service audits related to orders, referrals, civil complaints, etc. concerning the Ministry of National Defense, its affiliated agencies, subordinate organizations, and Armed Forces units and agencies.

rows.source_ko: 4. 자체감사 관련 감사자료의 수집ㆍ관리 및 전산화
rows.text_en: 4. Collection, Management, and Computerization of Audit Materials Related to Internal Audits

rows.source_ko: 5. 자체감사 처분요구에 대한 처리ㆍ종합
rows.text_en: 5. Processing and Summary of Disposition Requests from Internal Audits

rows.source_ko: 6. 자체감사 처분요구에 대한 이의신청 및 심사청구의 처리ㆍ종합
rows.text_en: 6. Processing and Comprehensive Review of Objections and Requests for Review Regarding Disposition Requests from Internal Audits

rows.source_ko: 7. 감사 업무실적의 분석 및 통계유지
rows.text_en: 7. Analysis of audit performance and maintenance of statistics

rows.source_ko: 8. 공직자 재산등록 관리, 선물ㆍ주식백지신탁 및 병역사항의 신고ㆍ접수
rows.text_en: 8. Management of public official asset registration, blind trusts for gifts and stocks, and reporting and receipt of military service matters

rows.source_ko: 제6조의2(정보보안정책관) ① 정보보안정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6-2 (Information Security Policy Officer) ① The Information Security Policy Officer shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 정보보안정책관 밑에 정보기획담당관ㆍ안보정보담당관ㆍ보안암호담당관 및 검증지원담당관 각 1명을 두되, 정보기획담당관은 영관급장교로, 안보정보담당관 및 보안암호담당관은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 검증지원담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② Under the Information Security Policy Officer, there shall be one Information Planning Officer, one Security Information Officer, one Security Cryptography Officer, and one Verification Support Officer. The Information Planning Officer shall be a field-grade officer, the Security Information Officer and the Security Cryptography Officer shall be a Science and Technology Secretary or Secretary, and the Verification Support Officer shall be a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ③ 정보기획담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 정보보안정책관을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Information Planning Officer assists the Information Security Policy Officer with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방분야 정보 정책의 수립 및 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, coordination, and control of information policy in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방분야 정보 관련 법령ㆍ제도의 개선 및 연구발전
rows.text_en: 2. Improvement of laws and systems related to information in the defense sector and research and development

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방정보본부 업무의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 3. Guidance and Supervision of Defense Intelligence Agency Operations

rows.source_ko: 4. 국방정보 관련 대내외 협력
rows.text_en: 4. Domestic and International Cooperation Related to Defense Information

rows.source_ko: 5. 「재외공관 무관주재령」 제2조에 따른 국군장교의 선발ㆍ운영 정책의 수립ㆍ발전
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and development of policies for the selection and operation of ROK Armed Forces officers pursuant to Article 2 of the "Ordinance on the Residence of Military Attachés at Overseas Diplomatic Missions"

rows.source_ko: 6. 주한(駐韓) 외국무관 관련 정책의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and coordination of policies regarding foreign military attachés in Korea

rows.source_ko: 7. 국방분야 지리공간정보(영상에 관한 정보를 포함한다) 관련 정책의 수립 및 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment, coordination, and control of policies related to geospatial information (including imagery information) in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방분야 기상정보 관련 정책의 수립 및 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment, coordination, and control of policies related to meteorological information in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖에 정책관 내 다른 담당관의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other officials within the Policy Bureau

rows.source_ko: ④ 안보정보담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 정보보안정책관을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Security Information Officer assists the Information Security Policy Officer with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방분야 방첩 정책의 수립 및 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, coordination, and control of counterintelligence policies in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방분야 방첩 관련 법령ㆍ제도의 개선 및 연구발전
rows.text_en: 2. Improvement of laws and systems related to counterintelligence in the defense sector and research and development

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방방첩본부 업무의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 3. Guidance and Supervision of Defense Counterintelligence Agency Operations

rows.source_ko: 4. 「국방방첩본부령」 제4조제1항에 따른 방첩정보활동기본지침의 수립
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of Basic Guidelines for Counterintelligence Information Activities Pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the "Ordinance of the National Defense Counterintelligence Headquarters"

rows.source_ko: 5. 「방위산업기술 보호법 시행령」 제5조에 따른 방위산업기술보호위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Operation of the Defense Industry Technology Protection Committee pursuant to Article 5 of the Enforcement Decree of the Defense Industry Technology Protection Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 국방 사이버보안 정책의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and Coordination of National Defense Cybersecurity Policy

rows.source_ko: 7. 국방 사이버보안 관련 대외협력
rows.text_en: 7. External cooperation regarding national defense cybersecurity

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방 사이버보안 분야 기술 개발 및 제도 발전
rows.text_en: 8. Technology Development and Institutional Advancement in the Field of National Defense Cybersecurity

rows.source_ko: 9. 국방부의 대테러 관련 정책의 수립ㆍ조정 및 대외협력
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment and coordination of the Ministry of National Defense's counter-terrorism policies and external cooperation

rows.source_ko: 10. 방위사업 분야 보안 관련 정책의 수립 및 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment, coordination, and control of security-related policies in the defense industry sector

rows.source_ko: 11. 국방방첩본부 및 국방보안지원단 관련 국방부 준법감찰기관(「국방방첩본부령」 제5조제5항 및 「국방보안지원단령」 제4조제5항에 따른 준법감찰기관을 말한다)의 운영 지원
rows.text_en: 11. Support for the operation of Ministry of National Defense compliance inspection agencies related to the Defense Counterintelligence Headquarters and the Defense Security Support Group ( referring to compliance inspection agencies pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 5 of the Defense Counterintelligence Headquarters Decree and Article 4, Paragraph 5 of the Defense Security Support Group Decree ).

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 보안암호담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 정보보안정책관을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Security Cryptography Officer assists the Information Security Policy Officer with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방분야 보안 정책의 수립 및 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, coordination, and control of security policies in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 군사보안 발전을 위한 법령ㆍ제도 개선 및 대외협력
rows.text_en: 2. Improvement of laws and systems and external cooperation for the advancement of military security

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방보안지원단 업무(「국방보안지원단령」 제3조제1항제5호의 업무는 제외한다)의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 3. Guidance and supervision of the duties of the Defense Security Support Group ( excluding the duties under Article 3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 5 of the "Defense Security Support Group Regulations" )

rows.source_ko: 4. 전군 보안감사의 총괄 및 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management, coordination, and control of security audits across the entire military

rows.source_ko: 5. 국방분야 암호 정책의 수립 및 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment, Coordination, and Control of Cryptography Policies in the Defense Sector

rows.source_ko: 6. 군사기밀의 분류, 관리 및 공개 정책의 수립ㆍ발전
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and Development of Policies on Classification, Management, and Disclosure of Military Secrets

rows.source_ko: 7. 「보안업무규정」 제3조의3에 따른 국방부 보안심사위원회의 운영 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for the operation of the Ministry of National Defense Security Review Committee pursuant to Article 3-3 of the "Security Affairs Regulations"

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방정보통신망 관련 설치 조정ㆍ통제 및 보안대책의 수립
rows.text_en: 8. Installation, coordination, control, and establishment of security measures related to the National Defense Information and Communications Network

rows.source_ko: 9. 군 정보통신장비 및 소프트웨어 보안정책의 수립
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment of security policies for military information and communications equipment and software

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 검증지원담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 정보보안정책관을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Verification Support Officer assists the Information Security Policy Officer with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 군 관련 인원의 정보 수집ㆍ제공 등 관계기관과의 협력(법령에 따라 요청받은 경우에 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Cooperation with relevant agencies, such as the collection and provision of information on military-related personnel (limited to cases where requested in accordance with laws and regulations)

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방보안지원단 업무(「국방보안지원단령」 제3조제1항제5호의 업무만 해당한다)의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 2. Guidance and supervision of the duties of the Defense Security Support Group ( limited to the duties under Article 3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 5 of the "Defense Security Support Group Regulations" )
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 14, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(운영지원과) 운영지원과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Operations Support Division) The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>
Article 8 Deleted <Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(국방정책실) ① 국방정책실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 장성급장교로 보하되, 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2012. 7. 26., 2013. 12. 12., 2017. 10. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Defense Policy Office) ① The Director of the Defense Policy Office shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service or general officers; provided, however, that in the case of appointment as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Jul. 26, 2012; Dec. 12, 2013; Oct. 18, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 「국방부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제1항에 따라 국방정책실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 정책기획관ㆍ국제정책관 및 방위정책관으로 하며, 정책기획관 및 방위정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 장성급장교로 보하되, 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 하고, 국제정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 7. 7., 2008. 12. 31., 2010. 12. 31., 2012. 7. 26., 2013. 12. 12., 2017. 10. 18., 2018. 1. 2., 2021. 3. 30., 2022. 7. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of the National Defense Policy Office shall be the Director of Policy Planning, the Director of International Policy, and the Director of Defense Policy. The Director of Policy Planning and the Director of Defense Policy shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service or general officers, provided that when appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of the position shall be Grade B, and the Director of International Policy shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Jul. 7, 2008; Dec. 31, 2008; Dec. 31, 2010; Jul. 26, 2012; Dec. 12, 2013; Oct. 18, 2017; Jan. 2, 2018; Mar. 30, 2021; Jul. 15, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ③ 정책기획관은 「국방부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제3항제1호부터 제5호까지, 제9호부터 제15호까지, 제24호부터 제30호까지 및 제32호부터 제35호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2021. 3. 30., 2022. 7. 15.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General for Policy Planning assists the Director General with respect to matters specified in Article 12, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 1 through 5, 9 through 15, 24 through 30, and 32 through 35 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Newly added Mar. 30, 2021; July 15, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ④ 국제정책관은「국방부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제3항제16호부터 제23호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2021. 3. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director-General for International Policy assists the Director-General with respect to matters under Article 12, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 16 through 23 of the “Organization of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Newly added Mar. 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 방위정책관은「국방부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제12조제3항제6호, 제8호, 제31호, 제36호부터 제38호까지 및 제41호의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <개정 2022. 7. 15., 2022. 12. 13., 2023. 4. 18., 2026. 1. 2., 2026. 8. 14.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director General for Defense Policy assists the Director General with respect to matters under Article 12, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 6, 8, 31, 36 through 38, and 41 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies. ” <Amended Jul. 15, 2022; Dec. 13, 2022; Apr. 18, 2023; Jan. 2, 2026; Aug. 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 국방정책실장 밑에 정책기획과ㆍ국방전략과ㆍ북한정책과ㆍ군비통제비확산정책과ㆍ교육훈련정책과ㆍ정신전력정책과ㆍ국제정책과ㆍ미국정책과ㆍ동북아정책과ㆍ국제평화협력과ㆍ인도태평양정책과ㆍ방위정책과ㆍ북핵대응정책과 및 미사일우주정책과를 두며, 정책기획과장ㆍ북한정책과장ㆍ교육훈련정책과장ㆍ정신전력정책과장ㆍ미국정책과장ㆍ방위정책과장ㆍ북핵대응정책과장 및 미사일우주정책과장은 영관급장교로, 국방전략과장ㆍ군비통제비확산정책과장ㆍ국제정책과장ㆍ동북아정책과장ㆍ국제평화협력과장 및 인도태평양정책과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2018. 1. 2., 2019. 12. 31., 2020. 4. 28., 2021. 3. 30., 2022. 7. 15., 2022. 12. 13., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 12., 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 7. 24., 2026. 1. 2., 2026. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Under the Director of the Office of Defense Policy, there shall be the Policy Planning Division, Defense Strategy Division, North Korea Policy Division, Arms Control and Non-Proliferation Policy Division, Education and Training Policy Division, Mental Power Policy Division, International Policy Division, U.S. Policy Division, Northeast Asia Policy Division, International Peace and Cooperation Division, Indo-Pacific Policy Division, Defense Policy Division, North Korean Nuclear Response Policy Division, and Missile and Space Policy Division. The heads of the Policy Planning Division, North Korea Policy Division, Education and Training Policy Division, Mental Power Policy Division, U.S. Policy Division, Defense Policy Division, North Korean Nuclear Response Policy Division, and Missile and Space Policy Division shall be field-grade officers, and the heads of the Defense Strategy Division, Arms Control and Non-Proliferation Policy Division, International Policy Division, Northeast Asia Policy Division, International Peace and Cooperation Division, and Indo-Pacific Policy Division shall be deputy directors, science and technology secretaries, or secretaries. <Amended Jan. 2, 2018; Dec. 31, 2019; Apr. 28, 2020; Mar. 30, 2021; Jul. 15, 2022; Dec. 13, 2022; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 12, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; Jul. 24, 2024; Jan. 2, 2026; Feb. 27, 2026>
⑦ The Head of the Policy Planning Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended May 26, 2009; Feb. 28, 2017; Mar. 30, 2021; Jul. 15, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 단기 국방정책의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation and Coordination of Short-term Defense Policy

rows.source_ko: 2. 전군주요지휘관회의 운영과 회의를 통한 단기 및 당해년도 국방정책 수립과 지침하달
rows.text_en: 2. Operation of the All-Army Major Commanders' Meeting and establishment of short-term and annual defense policies and issuance of guidelines through the meeting

rows.source_ko: 3. 국가 안보현안에 관한 국방정책의 수립ㆍ협조 및 조정
rows.text_en: 3. Formulation, coordination, and adjustment of defense policies regarding national security issues

rows.source_ko: 4. 국가안전보장회의(NSC) 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Affairs related to the National Security Council (NSC)

rows.source_ko: 5. 국가 안보현안 관련 청와대ㆍNSC 및 유관기관과의 업무 협조
rows.text_en: 5. Working cooperation with the Blue House, the NSC, and relevant agencies regarding national security issues

rows.source_ko: 6. 연두업무보고ㆍ국회업무보고 등 주요 국방정책보고
rows.text_en: 6. Major defense policy reports, such as the Annual Business Report and the National Assembly Business Report
7. Deleted <July 15, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 9. 국민과 대외기관 등을 대상으로 한 주요 국방정책 설명과 의견수렴 업무
rows.text_en: 9. Work involving the explanation of major defense policies and the collection of opinions from the public and external organizations

rows.source_ko: 10. 국제안보정세평가 및 안보정세평가회의 운영
rows.text_en: 10. Assessment of the International Security Situation and Operation of the Security Situation Assessment Conference

rows.source_ko: 10의2. 전시작전통제권 전환 관련 지침의 제공 및 추진상황의 점검
rows.text_en: 10-2. Provision of guidelines regarding the transfer of wartime operational control and monitoring of implementation status

rows.source_ko: 11. 그 밖에 실내 다른 과장의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other department heads

⑧ The Director of the Defense Strategy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended May 25, 2018; October 21, 2020; March 30, 2021; December 28, 2021; July 15, 2022; December 13, 2022; July 25, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 중장기 국방정책 및 국방전략의 수립ㆍ종합 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, synthesis, and coordination of mid-to-long-term defense policies and defense strategies

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방백서 등 대외정책보고서의 작성 및 발간
rows.text_en: 2. Preparation and publication of foreign policy reports, such as the Defense White Paper

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방개혁 업무에 관한 방향 제시
rows.text_en: 3. Presentation of direction regarding defense reform tasks

rows.source_ko: 4. 국가안보전략 관련 유관기관과의 협조
rows.text_en: 4. Cooperation with relevant agencies regarding national security strategy

rows.source_ko: 5. 국방정책 개발 및 발전
rows.text_en: 5. Development and Evolution of Defense Policy

rows.source_ko: 6. 국방정책 자문위원 편성 및 위원회 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Organization of Defense Policy Advisory Committee and Operation of the Committee

rows.source_ko: 7. 한국국방연구원 및 국가안전보장문제연구소와 그 밖의 국방정책 관련 국방부산하 연구기관 업무의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 7. Guidance and supervision of the operations of the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses, the National Security Research Institute, and other research institutions under the Ministry of National Defense related to defense policy

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방정책 관련 대외기관 요구사안에 대한 검토ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 8. Review and coordination of requests from external agencies regarding defense policy

rows.source_ko: 8의2. 제7호에 따른 연구기관의 국방정책 관련 중요사항 또는 대외민감 사안의 대외 발표내용에 대한 검토ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 8-2. Review and coordination of external announcements by research institutions pursuant to Subparagraph 7 regarding important matters related to national defense policy or externally sensitive issues

rows.source_ko: 9. 국방부군사편찬연구소 업무의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 9. Guidance and supervision of the operations of the Ministry of National Defense Military History Research Institute

rows.source_ko: 10. 국방기획지침의 작성
rows.text_en: 10. Preparation of National Defense Planning Guidelines

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 북한정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 7. 24., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Director of the North Korea Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jul. 24, 2024; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 정부의 대북ㆍ통일정책 관련 사항 중 군사분야에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the military sector among matters related to the government's North Korea and unification policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 북한의 대내외 및 대남정책 관련 분석ㆍ평가와 국방분야 대북정책 전략에 대한 수립ㆍ시행ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 2. Analysis and evaluation of North Korea's domestic, foreign, and South Korea policies, and the formulation, implementation, and control of defense-related strategies for North Korea policy

rows.source_ko: 4. 북한 급변사태 대비 및 군사 통합 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Tasks related to preparedness for a sudden crisis in North Korea and military integration

rows.source_ko: 5. 북방한계선(NLL), 서북도서 일대 및 한강하구 중립수역 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 5. Affairs related to the Northern Limit Line (NLL), the West West Islands area, and the neutral waters of the Han River estuary

rows.source_ko: 6. 대북현안 관련 정부기관 및 유엔군사령부와의 협조
rows.text_en: 6. Cooperation with government agencies and the United Nations Command regarding pending issues concerning North Korea

rows.source_ko: 9. 비무장지대(DMZ)ㆍ공동경비구역(JSA) 등 접경지역의 군사적 긴장완화 및 신뢰구축 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 9. Work related to military tension reduction and confidence-building in border areas, including the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) and the Joint Security Area (JSA)

rows.source_ko: 10. 남북관리구역 및 남북 군 통신선 운용 관련 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 10. Coordination and control regarding the operation of inter-Korean management zones and inter-Korean military communication lines

rows.source_ko: 11. 한반도 평화체제 전환 관련 군사분야 대책수립 및 정부정책의 지원
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment of military measures and support for government policies regarding the transition to a peace regime on the Korean Peninsula

rows.source_ko: 12. 남북군사회담 운영 및 관련 업무의 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 12. Operation of inter-Korean military talks and coordination and control of related affairs

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 군비통제비확산정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 7. 15., 2026. 10. 2.>
rows.text_en: 10. The Director of the Arms Control and Non-Proliferation Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jul. 15, 2022; Oct. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 군비통제 기본정책의 수립 및 관계부처ㆍ기관과의 협조에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the establishment of basic arms control policies and cooperation with relevant ministries and agencies

rows.source_ko: 2. 남ㆍ북한 군사적 신뢰구축방안의 수립 및 추진
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and Implementation of Inter-Korean Military Confidence-Building Measures

rows.source_ko: 3. 남ㆍ북한 군비통제대책의 수립 및 추진
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and Implementation of Inter-Korean Arms Control Measures

rows.source_ko: 4. 남ㆍ북한 군비통제 협상전략 및 관련지침의 수립
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of Inter-Korean Arms Control Negotiation Strategies and Related Guidelines

rows.source_ko: 5. 주요국가의 군비동향 및 군비통제활동에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning arms trends and arms control activities of major countries

rows.source_ko: 6. 군비통제 관련 감시ㆍ검증에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning monitoring and verification related to arms control

rows.source_ko: 7. 군비통제 관련 기구의 조정ㆍ통제ㆍ지도 및 감독
rows.text_en: 7. Coordination, control, guidance, and supervision of arms control-related organizations

rows.source_ko: 8. 군비통제 관련 각종 세미나 및 학술회의 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning various seminars and academic conferences, etc. related to arms control

rows.source_ko: 9. 국방부군비통제검증단 업무의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 9. Guidance and supervision of the operations of the Ministry of National Defense Arms Control Verification Group

rows.source_ko: 10. 국제군비통제 활동과 대책 수립
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment of International Arms Control Activities and Measures

rows.source_ko: 11. 지뢰ㆍ소형무기 등 재래식 무기의 군축ㆍ비확산에 관한 업무 및 관련 정책의 수립ㆍ이행
rows.text_en: 11. Tasks regarding the disarmament and non-proliferation of conventional weapons, such as landmines and small arms, and the formulation and implementation of related policies

rows.source_ko: 12. 대량살상무기체계와 관련된 전략물자 및 기술의 수출통제 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 12. Export control affairs regarding strategic materials and technologies related to weapons of mass destruction systems

rows.source_ko: 13. 군축 및 군비통제활동과 관련된 국제기구 및 회의체 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 13. Affairs related to international organizations and conferences concerning disarmament and arms control activities

rows.source_ko: 14. 화학ㆍ생물무기ㆍ우주ㆍ미사일의 군축, 비확산에 관한 업무 및 관련 정책의 수립ㆍ이행
rows.text_en: 14. Work on the disarmament and non-proliferation of chemical, biological, space, and missile weapons, and the formulation and implementation of related policies

rows.source_ko: 15. 확산방지구상(PSI) 관련 국방정책 수립 및 대내외 관계기관과의 협력업무
rows.text_en: 15. Formulation of defense policies related to the Proliferation Security Initiative (PSI) and cooperation with domestic and foreign agencies

rows.source_ko: 16. 국군포로 관련 정책의 수립ㆍ시행 및 국군포로 관련 기록의 관리
rows.text_en: 16. Establishment and Implementation of Policies Related to Republic of Korea Armed Forces POWs and Management of Records Related to Republic of Korea Armed Forces POWs

rows.source_ko: 17. 국군포로 및 가족의 생사확인ㆍ상봉ㆍ송환추진 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 17. Matters related to verifying the whereabouts, reunions, and repatriation of Korean War prisoners of war and their families

rows.source_ko: 18. 귀환포로 및 가족의 국내정착 지원
rows.text_en: 18. Support for the domestic settlement of repatriated prisoners of war and their families

rows.source_ko: 19. 국방분야 대북제재 전략 수립 및 관련 업무 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 19. Establishment of strategies for sanctions against North Korea in the defense sector and coordination and control of related tasks

rows.source_ko: 20. 유엔군사령부 관련 정책의 조정ㆍ통제 및 미국ㆍ유엔군사령부와의 협의
rows.text_en: 20. Coordination and control of policies related to the United Nations Command and consultation with the United States and the United Nations Command

rows.source_ko: 21. 정전협정 관련 정책의 조정ㆍ통제 및 유엔군사령부 군사정전위원회와의 협의
rows.text_en: 21. Coordination and control of policies related to the Armistice Agreement and consultation with the United Nations Command Military Armistice Commission

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 교육훈련정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 7. 15.>
rows.text_en: 11. The Head of the Education and Training Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended July 15, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방교육ㆍ훈련에 관한 정책과 계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of policies and plans regarding national defense education and training

rows.source_ko: 2. 군인 양성교육에 대한 정책의 수립 및 제도 발전
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of policies and development of systems for military training

rows.source_ko: 3. 직무 보수교육에 대한 정책의 수립 및 제도 발전
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment of policies and development of systems for job continuing education

rows.source_ko: 4. 부대 훈련에 대한 정책의 수립 및 제도 발전
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of policies and development of systems for unit training

rows.source_ko: 5. 과학화 교육ㆍ훈련에 대한 정책의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and coordination of policies regarding scientific education and training

rows.source_ko: 6. 교육ㆍ훈련 분야에 대한 분석ㆍ평가 및 감독
rows.text_en: 6. Analysis, evaluation, and supervision of the education and training sector

rows.source_ko: 7. 국방부 직할교육기관 및 각 군 교육사령부 등의 교육계획에 대한 조정 및 통제
rows.text_en: 7. Coordination and control of educational plans for educational institutions directly under the Ministry of National Defense and the Education Commands of each military branch, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 교육ㆍ훈련 관련 민원 업무의 처리
rows.text_en: 8. Handling of civil complaints related to education and training

rows.source_ko: 9. 교육 및 훈련 예산소요의 종합ㆍ검토 및 조정
rows.text_en: 9. Comprehensive review and coordination of education and training budget requirements

rows.source_ko: 10. 국방대학교, 합동군사대학교 및 국군간호사관학교 업무의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 10. Guidance and supervision of operations at the National Defense University, Joint Military University, and Armed Forces Nursing Academy
⑫ The Head of the Mental Power Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jul. 15, 2022; Dec. 12, 2023; Jul. 24, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방문화 정책의 개발ㆍ수립ㆍ조정 및 통제
rows.text_en: 1. Development, formulation, coordination, and control of national defense culture policy

rows.source_ko: 2. 군 문화예술 활성화를 위한 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and implementation of plans for the revitalization of culture and arts in the county

rows.source_ko: 3. 국제 군 문화교류에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning international military cultural exchange

rows.source_ko: 4. 병영도서관 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the operation of the military library

rows.source_ko: 5. 병영 내 도서 보급에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the supply of books within the barracks

rows.source_ko: 6. 군 국가유산 보호 및 전사적지 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the protection of military national heritage and the management of battlefield sites

rows.source_ko: 7. 군내 문화사업의 심사분석 및 평가 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Review, analysis, and evaluation of cultural projects within the county

rows.source_ko: 8. 전쟁기념사업회 업무의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 8. Guidance and supervision of the War Memorial of Korea's operations

rows.source_ko: 9. 국방정신전력원 업무의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 9. Guidance and Supervision of Operations at the National Defense Mental Power Institute

rows.source_ko: 10. 국방 정신전력교육정책의 수립ㆍ시행과 연구ㆍ발전
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment, Implementation, Research, and Development of National Defense Mental Power Education Policies

rows.source_ko: 11. 국방 정신전력교육에 관한 계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment and coordination of plans regarding national defense mental power education

rows.source_ko: 12. 부대 및 학교기관의 정신전력교육지침 수립과 계획의 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 12. Establishment of guidelines for mental strength education in units and educational institutions, and coordination and control of plans

rows.source_ko: 13. 정신전력교육 교재 등의 제작 및 보급 업무
rows.text_en: 13. Production and distribution of mental warfare education materials, etc.

rows.source_ko: 14. 장병 안보교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Matters concerning security education for soldiers

rows.source_ko: 15. 학교ㆍ단체 등의 안보교육 요청 시 군 지원 활동에 대한 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 15. Overall management and coordination of military support activities upon request for security education from schools, organizations, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑬ 국제정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 7. 15., 2023. 7. 25.>
rows.text_en: 13. The Director of the International Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jul. 15, 2022; Jul. 25, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 대외 국방정책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of foreign defense policy

rows.source_ko: 2. 군사에 관한 조약 및 협정의 체결ㆍ수정에 관한 협의
rows.text_en: 2. Consultations on the Conclusion and Amendment of Treaties and Agreements Concerning Military Affairs

rows.source_ko: 3. 주요 대외 군사정세[미ㆍ일ㆍ중ㆍ러ㆍ독립국가연합ㆍ동남아시아국가ㆍ서남아시아ㆍ중동 및 아프리카 국가와 관련된 경우를 제외한다]의 분석과 대책 수립
rows.text_en: 3. Analysis of major external military situations [excluding cases involving the U.S., Japan, China, Russia, the Commonwealth of Independent States, Southeast Asian countries, Southwest Asian countries, and countries in the Middle East and Africa] and formulation of countermeasures

rows.source_ko: 4. 미ㆍ일ㆍ중ㆍ러ㆍ독립국가연합ㆍ동남아시아국가ㆍ서남아시아ㆍ중동 및 아프리카 국가를 제외한 국가 간 군사외교활동, 다자안보 협의, 협의체 관련 정책 수립 및 업무의 조정
rows.text_en: 4. Military and diplomatic activities, multilateral security consultations, and the formulation of policies and coordination of affairs related to consultative bodies among countries excluding the United States, Japan, China, Russia, the Commonwealth of Independent States, Southeast Asian countries, Southwest Asian countries, and countries in the Middle East and Africa.

rows.source_ko: 5. 국가외교활동 중 국방분야 소관사항의 지원 및 협조
rows.text_en: 5. Support and cooperation on matters under the jurisdiction of the defense sector during national diplomatic activities

rows.source_ko: 6. 참전국 군사외교활동 총괄ㆍ조정 및 지원
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management, coordination, and support of military diplomatic activities of participating countries

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 실내 다른 과장의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 국제정책 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other international policy matters not under the jurisdiction of other division heads within the office

rows.source_ko: 8. 서울안보대화(SDD) 관련 계획 수립, 대내ㆍ외 협조 및 업무의 조정ㆍ통제 관련 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the formulation of plans, internal and external coordination, and the coordination and control of operations related to the Seoul Security Dialogue (SDD)

rows.source_ko: 9. 군사외교와 관련한 외국 주요 인사의 경호ㆍ의전에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the security and protocol of key foreign figures in relation to military diplomacy

rows.source_ko: ⑭ 미국정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 7. 15.>
rows.text_en: 14. The Director of the U.S. Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended July 15, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 대미 국방정책의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation and Coordination of Defense Policy toward the U.S.

rows.source_ko: 2. 한ㆍ미 안보협의회 및 한ㆍ미정책검토위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Operation of the ROK-U.S. Security Consultative Meeting and the ROK-U.S. Policy Review Committee

rows.source_ko: 3. 방위비 분담 업무의 주관 및 주둔군 지원에 관한 사항의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Responsibility for defense cost-sharing and overall management and coordination of matters concerning support for stationed forces

rows.source_ko: 4. 대미 국방교류 및 협력업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management and coordination of defense exchanges and cooperation with the U.S.

rows.source_ko: 5. 북한과 미국의 관계 분석 및 대책 수립
rows.text_en: 5. Analysis of North Korea-U.S. Relations and Formulation of Countermeasures

rows.source_ko: 6. 한ㆍ미동맹 관련 다자간 군사안보협력 정책의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and coordination of multilateral military and security cooperation policies related to the ROK-U.S. alliance

rows.source_ko: 7. 미국 관련 다자안보 협의, 협력체 관련 정책 수립 및 업무의 조정
rows.text_en: 7. Multilateral security consultations regarding the United States, formulation of policies related to cooperation bodies, and coordination of operations

rows.source_ko: ⑮ 동북아정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 7. 15., 2023. 7. 25.>
rows.text_en: 15. The Director of the Northeast Asia Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jul. 15, 2022; Jul. 25, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 동북아국가 및 독립국가연합(중앙아시아 국가는 제외한다)과의 국방외교정책의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation and coordination of defense and foreign policies with Northeast Asian countries and the Commonwealth of Independent States (excluding Central Asian countries)

rows.source_ko: 2. 동북아국가 및 독립국가연합(중앙아시아 국가는 제외한다)과의 군사교류 및 협력업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of military exchanges and cooperation with Northeast Asian countries and the Commonwealth of Independent States (excluding Central Asian countries)

rows.source_ko: 3. 동북아국가 및 독립국가연합(중앙아시아 국가는 제외한다)과의 국방정책 협의채널 운영 및 국방주요 현안 협의 및 조정
rows.text_en: 3. Operation of defense policy consultation channels with Northeast Asian countries and the Commonwealth of Independent States (excluding Central Asian countries), and consultation and coordination on major defense issues

rows.source_ko: 4. 동북아국가 및 독립국가연합(중앙아시아 국가는 제외한다)의 주요 군사정세 분석과 대책 수립
rows.text_en: 4. Analysis of major military situations and formulation of countermeasures in Northeast Asian countries and the Commonwealth of Independent States (excluding Central Asian countries).

rows.source_ko: 5. 동북아국가 및 독립국가연합(중앙아시아 국가는 제외한다)과의 군 지도부 대외활동의 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 5. Coordination and control of the military leadership's external activities with Northeast Asian countries and the Commonwealth of Independent States (excluding Central Asian countries)

rows.source_ko: 6. 국가외교활동 중 동북아국가 및 독립국가연합(중앙아시아 국가는 제외한다)과의 국방분야 소관사항 지원 및 협조
rows.text_en: 6. Support and cooperation on defense matters under the jurisdiction of Northeast Asian countries and the Commonwealth of Independent States (excluding Central Asian countries) during national diplomatic activities

rows.source_ko: 7. 동북아국가 및 독립국가연합(중앙아시아 국가는 제외한다) 관련 다자안보 협의, 협력체 관련 정책 수립 및 업무의 조정
rows.text_en: 7. Multilateral security consultations and the formulation of policies and coordination of affairs related to cooperation bodies concerning Northeast Asian countries and the Commonwealth of Independent States (excluding Central Asian countries)
16. The Director of the International Peace and Cooperation Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jul. 15, 2022; Jul. 24, 2024; Feb. 27, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방분야의 국제평화유지활동 및 다국적군활동 관련 정책개발 및 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Policy development and overall management of operations related to international peacekeeping and multinational forces in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방분야의 국제평화유지활동 및 다국적군활동 참여 관련 법령 및 제도 정비
rows.text_en: 2. Revision of laws and systems related to participation in international peacekeeping and multinational force activities in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방분야의 국제평화유지활동 및 다국적군활동 관련 대내ㆍ외 협조
rows.text_en: 3. Domestic and international cooperation regarding international peacekeeping and multinational force activities in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 4. 국제연합(UN) 상비체제 검토 및 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Review and Management of the United Nations (UN) Standing System

rows.source_ko: 5. 국제평화유지활동 관련 다자 간 교류협력 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Support for multilateral exchange and cooperation related to international peacekeeping operations

rows.source_ko: 6. 해외파병부대 운영, 파병연장 및 철수 관련 정책 수립ㆍ조정 및 통제
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment, coordination, and control of policies regarding the operation of overseas deployed units, extension of deployment, and withdrawal

rows.source_ko: 7. 해외파병부대 관련 위기관리 지원 및 협조(재외국민 보호를 위한 군 지원 업무를 포함한다)
rows.text_en: 7. Support and cooperation for crisis management related to overseas deployed units (including military support duties for the protection of overseas nationals)

rows.source_ko: 8. 유엔사령부 후방기지 방문 사업과 관련된 업무 지원
rows.text_en: 8. Business support related to the UN Command rear base visit program

rows.source_ko: ⑰ 인도태평양정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 7. 15., 2024. 7. 24.>
rows.text_en: 17. The Director General of the Indo-Pacific Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jul. 15, 2022; Jul. 24, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 동남아시아국가 및 서남아시아국가 다자안보 협의 및 협력체 관련 정책 수립 및 업무의 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Policy formulation and coordination of work related to multilateral security consultations and cooperation bodies of Southeast Asian and Southwest Asian countries

rows.source_ko: 2. 다자간 군사안보협력 관련 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of affairs related to multilateral military and security cooperation

rows.source_ko: 3. 동남아시아국가 및 서남아시아국가의 주요 군사정세 분석과 대책 수립
rows.text_en: 3. Analysis of Major Military Situations in Southeast Asian and Southwest Asian Countries and Formulation of Countermeasures

rows.source_ko: 4. 동남아시아국가 및 서남아시아국가와의 군사외교활동
rows.text_en: 4. Military and diplomatic activities with Southeast Asian and Southwest Asian countries

rows.source_ko: 5. 아세안 및 태평양도서국 관련 지역 협력
rows.text_en: 5. Regional cooperation involving ASEAN and Pacific Island nations

rows.source_ko: ⑱ 방위정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 7. 15., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: 18. The Director of the Defense Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jul. 15, 2022; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 장관의 군령 보좌에 관한 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of assistance to the Minister in military command

rows.source_ko: 2. 군사적 위기상황에 대한 국방부 대응 총괄
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management of the Ministry of National Defense's response to military crises

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방부 위기관리 정책의 수립ㆍ발전 및 국방부 위기관리 기구의 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and Development of Ministry of National Defense Crisis Management Policies and Operation of Ministry of National Defense Crisis Management Organizations

rows.source_ko: 4. 전방위 안보위협 대비 한ㆍ미 연합방위태세 유지 및 발전
rows.text_en: 4. Maintaining and Developing the ROK-U.S. Combined Defense Posture in Preparation for All-Around Security Threats

rows.source_ko: 5. 전쟁지도ㆍ수행체계의 개선 발전
rows.text_en: 5. Improvement and Development of War Leadership and Execution Systems

rows.source_ko: 6. 전시 국방정책의 수립 및 분야별 전시 국방정책의 조정
rows.text_en: 6. Formulation of wartime defense policy and coordination of wartime defense policy by sector

rows.source_ko: 8. 방위정책의 개발 및 발전, 유관부서와의 협조
rows.text_en: 8. Development and advancement of defense policy, and cooperation with relevant departments

rows.source_ko: 9. 국방부 및 국방부 직할부대ㆍ기관의 정부연습 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 9. Overall management of government exercise operations by the Ministry of National Defense and its directly affiliated units and agencies

rows.source_ko: ⑲ 북핵대응정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2022. 7. 15.>
rows.text_en: 19. The Director of the North Korean Nuclear Response Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended July 15, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 북핵ㆍ대량살상무기 대응 관련 국방분야 정책의 수립 및 위기관리
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation of defense policies and crisis management regarding the response to North Korea's nuclear weapons and weapons of mass destruction

rows.source_ko: 2. 북핵ㆍ대량살상무기 동향 분석ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 2. Analysis and Evaluation of Trends in North Korea's Nuclear Program and Weapons of Mass Destruction

rows.source_ko: 3. 북핵ㆍ대량살상무기 관련 정부부처ㆍ기관과의 협조
rows.text_en: 3. Cooperation with government ministries and agencies regarding North Korea's nuclear program and weapons of mass destruction

rows.source_ko: 4. 북핵ㆍ대량살상무기 관련 회의체의 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Operation of the consultative body regarding North Korea's nuclear program and weapons of mass destruction

rows.source_ko: 5. 확장억제정책 발전 및 추진전략의 수립
rows.text_en: 5. Development of Extended Containment Policy and Establishment of Implementation Strategies

rows.source_ko: 6. 한ㆍ미 억제전략위원회ㆍ확장억제전략협의체 관련 기획 및 운영, 대미협의 전략 수립에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the planning and operation of the ROK-U.S. Deterrence Strategy Committee and the Extended Deterrence Strategy Consultative Body, and the formulation of strategies for consultations with the U.S.

rows.source_ko: 7. 한ㆍ미 확장억제수단 운용 연습(TTX) 기획ㆍ발전
rows.text_en: 7. Planning and Development of ROK-U.S. Extended Deterrence Operation Exercise (TTX)

rows.source_ko: 8. 북핵 6자회담 및 비핵화 관련 정부정책에 대한 지원
rows.text_en: 8. Support for government policies regarding the Six-Party Talks and denuclearization of the North Korean nuclear issue

rows.text_en: Article 10 (Personnel and Welfare Office) ① The Head of the Personnel and Welfare Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Dec. 12, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 「국방부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제13조제1항에 따라 인사복지실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 인사기획관ㆍ예비전력정책관 및 보건복지관으로 하며, 인사기획관ㆍ예비전력정책관 및 보건복지관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2017. 10. 18., 2019. 12. 31., 2021. 3. 30., 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of Personnel and Welfare shall be the Director General for Personnel Planning, the Director General for Reserve Force Policy, and the Director General for Health and Welfare; these positions shall be filled by general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of these positions shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Oct. 18, 2017; Dec. 31, 2019; Mar. 30, 2021; Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 인사기획관은「국방부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제13조제3항제1호부터 제6호까지, 제8호부터 제13호까지, 제15호 및 제16호의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다. <신설 2021. 3. 30., 2022. 2. 22.>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 인사복지실장 밑에 인사기획관리과ㆍ인력정책과ㆍ병영정책과ㆍ인적자원개발과ㆍ군종정책과ㆍ군무원정책과ㆍ군무원채용팀ㆍ군인사운영팀ㆍ예비전력기획과ㆍ자원동원과ㆍ예비군훈련정책과ㆍ복지정책과ㆍ국방일자리정책과ㆍ보건정책과ㆍ군인연금과ㆍ군인재해보상과 및 감염병대응팀을 두며, 병영정책과장ㆍ인적자원개발과장ㆍ군종정책과장ㆍ예비군훈련정책과장 및 복지정책과장은 영관급장교로, 인사기획관리과장ㆍ인력정책과장ㆍ군무원정책과장ㆍ예비전력기획과장ㆍ자원동원과장ㆍ국방일자리정책과장ㆍ보건정책과장ㆍ군인연금과장 및 군인재해보상과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 군무원채용팀장ㆍ군인사운영팀장 및 감염병대응팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ임업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ환경사무관ㆍ항공사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 사서사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26., 2025. 2. 25., 2026. 2. 27.>
