rows.source_ko: 제11조의2(국방인공지능기획국) ① 국방인공지능기획국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11-2 (National Defense Artificial Intelligence Planning Bureau) ① The Director of the National Defense Artificial Intelligence Planning Bureau shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 국방인공지능기획국에 국방인공지능정책과ㆍ국방데이터정책과ㆍ유무인복합체계과를 두며, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Defense Artificial Intelligence Planning Bureau shall have the Defense Artificial Intelligence Policy Division, the Defense Data Policy Division, and the Manned/Unmanned Combined Systems Division, and the heads of each division shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ③ 국방인공지능정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Defense Artificial Intelligence Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방분야 인공지능 발전 정책ㆍ전략의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of policies and strategies for the development of artificial intelligence in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방분야 인공지능 관련 법규의 연구 및 발전
rows.text_en: 2. Research and Development of Regulations Related to Artificial Intelligence in the Defense Sector

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방분야 인공지능 기반 구축을 위한 제도 발전
rows.text_en: 3. Institutional Development for Establishing an AI Foundation in the Defense Sector

rows.source_ko: 4. 국방분야 인공지능 확산을 위한 사업의 계획ㆍ조정ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 4. Planning, Coordination, and Management of Projects for the Dissemination of Artificial Intelligence in the Defense Sector

rows.source_ko: 5. 국방분야 인공지능 인재양성 업무
rows.text_en: 5. AI Talent Development in the Defense Sector

rows.source_ko: 6. 국방분야 인공지능 관련 협의체 운영 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Operation of consultative bodies related to artificial intelligence in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 7. 국방분야 인공지능 관련 대내외 협력 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Internal and external cooperation activities related to artificial intelligence in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방분야 생성형 인공지능 개발ㆍ발전에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 8. Tasks related to the development and advancement of generative artificial intelligence in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖에 국 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 인공지능 관련 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Other matters related to artificial intelligence not under the jurisdiction of other domestic departments

rows.source_ko: ④ 국방데이터정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Defense Data Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방분야 데이터 전략ㆍ정책의 수립, 시행 및 제도 발전
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of data strategies and policies, and institutional development in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방분야 데이터 기술 관련 정책의 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of policies related to data technology in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방분야 데이터 기술 분야 국제교류 및 국제협력의 활성화 추진
rows.text_en: 3. Promoting the revitalization of international exchange and cooperation in the field of data technology in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 4. 국방분야 데이터 관련 윤리 기준의 개발 및 보급 시책의 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and implementation of policies for the development and dissemination of ethical standards related to data in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 5. 국방분야 데이터 기반 지능형 서비스 활성화 정책의 수립 및 기반 조성
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of policies and foundation for activating data-based intelligent services in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 6. 국방분야 데이터 활용사업의 소요기획 및 검토ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Requirements Planning, Review, and Coordination of Data Utilization Projects in the Defense Sector

rows.source_ko: 7. 국방분야 데이터 인프라의 발전 및 전담기관 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Development of data infrastructure in the defense sector and operation of a dedicated agency

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방데이터책임관 제도 및 관련 협의체 운영
rows.text_en: 8. Operation of the Defense Data Officer System and Related Consultative Bodies

rows.source_ko: 9. 국방데이터 공유ㆍ제공 활성화 계획의 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment and Implementation of a Plan to Promote the Sharing and Provision of National Defense Data

rows.source_ko: 10. 국방데이터의 품질관리 및 제도 발전
rows.text_en: 10. Quality Management of Defense Data and Institutional Development

rows.source_ko: 11. 국방분야 개인정보보호에 관한 정책 수립 및 발전
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment and Development of Policies on Personal Information Protection in the Defense Sector

rows.source_ko: 12. 부 내 공공데이터의 제공 및 이용 활성화에 관한 계획의 수립ㆍ추진 및 평가 등 총괄
rows.text_en: 12. Overall management of the establishment, implementation, and evaluation of plans regarding the provision and promotion of the use of public data within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: 13. 부 내 데이터기반행정 활성화를 위한 계획의 수립ㆍ추진 및 데이터 관리 등 총괄
rows.text_en: 13. Overall management of planning, implementation, and data management for the activation of data-based administration within the Ministry

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 유무인복합체계과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Manned/Unmanned Combined System Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 인공지능 기반 유ㆍ무인 복합체계 분야 정책 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of policies in the field of AI-based manned and unmanned hybrid systems

rows.source_ko: 2. 인공지능 기반 유ㆍ무인 복합체계 성과점검ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 2. Performance Monitoring and Management of AI-based Manned and Unmanned Hybrid Systems

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방 드론ㆍ로봇 분야 발전 전략 수립 및 성과관리
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment of Development Strategies and Performance Management for the Defense Drone and Robot Sector

rows.source_ko: 4. 계열화ㆍ모듈화 기반 무인체계 구축 및 제도 발전
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of Unmanned Systems Based on Systematization and Modularization and Institutional Development

rows.source_ko: 5. 드론ㆍ로봇 분야 민ㆍ군 협력사업 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Planning and coordination of civil-military cooperation projects in the drone and robot sectors

[This Article was newly inserted on Jan. 2, 2026.]
[Formerly Article 11-2 was moved to Article 11-3 <Jan. 2, 2026>]

rows.source_ko: 제11조의3(전력정책국) ① 전력정책국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 장성급장교로 보하되, 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11-3 (Electricity Policy Bureau) ① The Director of the Electricity Policy Bureau shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service or general officers; provided, however, that in the case of appointment as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 전력정책국장 밑에 전력정책과ㆍ기반전력과 및 공통전력과를 두며, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 7. 24.>
rows.text_en: ② The Electric Power Policy Division, the Infrastructure Electric Power Division, and the Common Electric Power Division shall be established under the Director General of the Electric Power Policy Bureau, and the heads of each division shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; Jul. 24, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 전력정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Electric Power Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 군사력건설 관련 정책의 수립ㆍ조정 및 통제
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation, coordination, and control of policies related to military force building

rows.source_ko: 2. 군사력건설에 관한 제도 및 법령의 정비 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Tasks for the improvement of systems and laws regarding military force development

rows.source_ko: 3. 방위력개선 관련 국제협력에 관한 업무(국방과학기술에 대한 국제협력은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning international cooperation related to defense capability improvement (excluding international cooperation on defense science and technology)

rows.source_ko: 4. 방위력개선 사업의 시험평가 제도 발전
rows.text_en: 4. Development of the Test and Evaluation System for Defense Capability Improvement Projects

rows.source_ko: 5. 국방대학교 사업관리교육과정의 편성ㆍ운영 및 통제
rows.text_en: 5. Organization, Operation, and Control of the National Defense University Project Management Education Curriculum

rows.source_ko: 6. 방위사업청의 국방부장관 승인 및 보고사항에 관한 검토
rows.text_en: 6. Review of matters requiring the Defense Acquisition Program Administration's approval and reporting to the Minister of National Defense

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 국 내 다른 과장의 주관에 속하지 않는 군사력건설에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters concerning military force development that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other domestic division heads

rows.source_ko: ④ 기반전력과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 7. 24.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Infrastructure and Power Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended July 24, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 방위력개선(기동ㆍ화력전력, 함정전력, 항공기전력 등 기반전력) 사업을 위한 무기체계 등의 소요결정 관련 업무 협조
rows.text_en: 1. Coordination of tasks related to the determination of requirements for weapon systems, etc., for defense capability improvement projects (basic forces such as mobility and firepower forces, naval forces, and aircraft forces)

rows.source_ko: 2. 방위력개선(기동ㆍ화력전력, 함정전력, 항공기전력 등 기반전력) 사업의 국방중기계획의 수립 및 가용재원 판단ㆍ배분 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of the Mid-term National Defense Plan for defense capability improvement projects (basic forces such as mobility and firepower, naval forces, and air power) and assessment and allocation of available resources

rows.source_ko: 3. 방위력개선(기동ㆍ화력전력, 함정전력, 항공기전력 등 기반전력) 사업의 소요검증 업무
rows.text_en: 3. Requirements verification work for defense capability improvement projects (basic forces such as mobile and firepower forces, naval forces, and aircraft forces)

rows.source_ko: 4. 방위력개선(기동ㆍ화력전력, 함정전력, 항공기전력 등 기반전력) 사업의 시험평가 계획 수립ㆍ결과 판정 및 분석평가 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Tasks related to the establishment of test and evaluation plans, determination of results, and analysis and evaluation of defense capability improvement projects (basic forces such as mobility and firepower forces, naval forces, and aircraft forces).

rows.source_ko: 5. 방위력개선(기동ㆍ화력전력, 함정전력, 항공기전력 등 기반전력) 사업 관련 업무 조정 및 통제
rows.text_en: 5. Coordination and control of tasks related to defense capability improvement projects (basic forces such as mobility and firepower, naval forces, and aircraft forces)

rows.source_ko: 6. 방위력개선(기동ㆍ화력전력, 함정전력, 항공기전력 등 기반전력) 사업의 전시예산 편성에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the formulation of the wartime budget for defense capability improvement projects (basic forces such as mobile and firepower forces, naval forces, and aircraft forces)

rows.source_ko: 7. 방위력개선 사업의 국방중기계획 및 예산편성 작성 지침 수립
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment of Guidelines for the Preparation of the Mid-term National Defense Plan and Budget Formulation for Defense Capability Improvement Projects

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 공통전력과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 7. 24.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Common Power Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended July 24, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 방위력개선(지상무인전력, 감시ㆍ정찰전력, 지휘ㆍ통제ㆍ통신전력, 유도무기전력 등 공통전력) 사업을 위한 무기체계 등의 소요결정 관련 업무 협조
rows.text_en: 1. Coordination of tasks related to the determination of requirements for weapon systems, etc., for defense capability improvement projects (common forces such as ground unmanned forces, surveillance and reconnaissance forces, command, control and communications forces, and guided weapon forces).

rows.source_ko: 2. 방위력개선(지상무인전력, 감시ㆍ정찰전력, 지휘ㆍ통제ㆍ통신전력, 유도무기전력 등 공통전력) 사업의 국방중기계획의 수립 및 가용재원 판단ㆍ배분 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of the Mid-term National Defense Plan and assessment and allocation of available resources for defense capability improvement projects (common forces including ground unmanned forces, surveillance and reconnaissance forces, command, control and communications forces, and guided missile forces).

rows.source_ko: 3. 방위력개선(지상무인전력, 감시ㆍ정찰전력, 지휘ㆍ통제ㆍ통신전력, 유도무기전력 등 공통전력) 사업의 소요검증 업무
rows.text_en: 3. Requirements verification work for defense capability improvement projects (common forces such as ground unmanned forces, surveillance and reconnaissance forces, command, control and communications forces, and guided weapon forces)

rows.source_ko: 4. 방위력개선(지상무인전력, 감시ㆍ정찰전력, 지휘ㆍ통제ㆍ통신전력, 유도무기전력 등 공통전력) 사업의 시험평가 계획 수립ㆍ결과 판정 및 분석평가 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Tasks related to the establishment of test and evaluation plans, determination of results, and analysis and evaluation for defense capability improvement projects (common forces such as ground unmanned forces, surveillance and reconnaissance forces, command, control and communications forces, and guided weapon forces).

rows.source_ko: 5. 방위력개선(지상무인전력, 감시ㆍ정찰전력, 지휘ㆍ통제ㆍ통신전력, 유도무기전력 등 공통전력) 사업 관련 업무 조정 및 통제
rows.text_en: 5. Coordination and control of tasks related to defense capability improvement projects (common forces such as ground unmanned forces, surveillance and reconnaissance forces, command, control and communications forces, and guided missile forces).

rows.source_ko: 6. 방위력개선(지상무인전력, 감시ㆍ정찰전력, 지휘ㆍ통제ㆍ통신전력, 유도무기전력 등 공통전력) 사업의 전시예산 편성에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the formulation of the wartime budget for defense capability improvement projects (common forces such as ground unmanned forces, surveillance and reconnaissance forces, command, control and communications forces, and guided missile forces).

rows.source_ko: 7. 방위력개선 사업의 소요검증ㆍ분석평가 제도 발전
rows.text_en: 7. Development of the Requirements Verification and Analysis & Evaluation System for Defense Capability Improvement Projects

[This Article newly inserted July 25, 2023]
[Moved from Article 11-2 <Jan 2, 2026>]

rows.source_ko: 제11조의4(국방정보화국) ① 국방정보화국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11-4 (Defense Informationization Bureau) ① The Director of the Defense Informationization Bureau shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 국방정보화국에 국방정보화정책과ㆍ국방정보화기반과ㆍ사이버전자기정책과 및 소프트웨어융합팀을 두며, 국방정보화정책과장 및 사이버전자기정책과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 국방정보화기반과장은 영관급장교로, 소프트웨어융합팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ임업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ환경사무관ㆍ항공사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 사서사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Defense Informationization Bureau shall have the Defense Informationization Policy Division, the Defense Informationization Infrastructure Division, the Cyber Electromagnetic Policy Division, and the Software Convergence Team. The heads of the Defense Informationization Policy Division and the Cyber Electromagnetic Policy Division shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary; the head of the Defense Informationization Infrastructure Division shall be appointed as a field-grade officer; and the head of the Software Convergence Team shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Forestry Officer, Health Officer, Environment Officer, Aviation Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, Administrative Officer, or Library Officer.

rows.source_ko: ③ 국방정보화정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the National Defense Information Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방정보화책임관(CIO)제도의 운영 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 1. Duties related to the operation of the Defense Chief Information Officer (CIO) system

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방정보화 추진정책 및 발전계획의 수립ㆍ조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment, coordination, and control of defense informatization promotion policies and development plans
3. Deleted <Aug. 14, 2026>
5. Deleted <Aug. 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 6. 국방정보화 업무절차의 개선 및 개혁 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Tasks related to the improvement and reform of defense informatization work procedures

rows.source_ko: 7. 국방정보화 관련 법규 및 제도의 연구ㆍ발전
rows.text_en: 7. Research and development of laws and systems related to national defense informatization

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방정보화 사업의 소요검토
rows.text_en: 8. Requirements Review for National Defense Informatization Projects

rows.source_ko: 제11조의5(군수관리국) ① 군수관리국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11-5 (Logistics Management Bureau) ① The Director of the Logistics Management Bureau shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 군수관리국에 군수기획과ㆍ장비관리과ㆍ물자관리과ㆍ탄약수송관리과ㆍ재난안전관리과 및 군수지능화팀을 두며, 군수기획과장ㆍ물자관리과장 및 재난안전관리과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 장비관리과장 및 탄약수송관리과장은 영관급장교로, 군수지능화팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ임업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ환경사무관ㆍ항공사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 사서사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Logistics Management Bureau shall have the Logistics Planning Division, Equipment Management Division, Material Management Division, Ammunition Transport Management Division, Disaster and Safety Management Division, and Logistics Intelligence Team. The heads of the Logistics Planning Division, Material Management Division, and Disaster and Safety Management Division shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary; the heads of the Equipment Management Division and Ammunition Transport Management Division shall be appointed as Field-grade officers; and the heads of the Logistics Intelligence Team shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Forestry Officer, Health Officer, Environment Officer, Aviation Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, Administrative Officer, or Library Officer.

rows.source_ko: 제11조의6(군사시설국) ① 군사시설국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11-6 (Military Facilities Bureau) ① The Director of the Military Facilities Bureau shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 군사시설국에 시설기획과ㆍ시설제도과ㆍ건설관리과ㆍ부대건설과ㆍ국유재산과ㆍ군주거정책과ㆍ환경소음팀 및 지뢰대응활동팀을 두며, 시설기획과장ㆍ시설제도과장ㆍ건설관리과장ㆍ부대건설과장ㆍ국유재산과장 및 군주거정책과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 환경소음팀장 및 지뢰대응활동팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ임업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ환경사무관ㆍ항공사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 사서사무관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Military Facilities Bureau shall have the Facilities Planning Division, Facilities System Division, Construction Management Division, Unit Construction Division, State Property Division, Military Housing Policy Division, Environment and Noise Team, and Mine Response Team; the heads of the Facilities Planning Division, Facilities System Division, Construction Management Division, Unit Construction Division, State Property Division, and Military Housing Policy Division shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary, and the heads of the Environment and Noise Team and Mine Response Team shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Forestry Officer, Health Officer, Environment Officer, Aviation Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, Administrative Officer, or Library Officer.

rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Facilities Planning Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.text_en: 11. Other matters related to facilities not under the jurisdiction of other domestic divisions and teams

rows.text_en: 9. Operation of the ROK-US Facilities and Areas Subcommittee under the Status of Forces Agreement

rows.source_ko: 10. 방위비분담시설사업 추진 관련 대미 협의
rows.text_en: 10. Consultations with the U.S. regarding the promotion of defense cost-sharing facility projects

rows.source_ko: 11. 방위비분담시설사업의 집행 승인 및 조정ㆍ통제
rows.text_en: 11. Approval of Execution and Coordination/Control of Defense Cost-Sharing Facility Projects

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 건설관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Construction Management Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 군사시설 건설계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of military facility construction plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 군 시설의 운영ㆍ보수에 관한 정책수립 및 사업집행 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Policy formulation and project execution management regarding the operation and maintenance of military facilities

rows.source_ko: 3. 군 시설 설치계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and coordination of plans for the installation of military facilities

rows.source_ko: 4. 군 건설공사를 위한 관계부처와의 협의
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation with relevant ministries for military construction projects

rows.source_ko: 5. 시설물의 안전관리에 관한 계획의 수립ㆍ조정 및 통제

rows.source_ko: 6. 국방분야 민간투자 시설사업의 계획ㆍ집행ㆍ운영 및 유지관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the planning, execution, operation, and maintenance of private investment facility projects in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 7. 군사시설 민간투자사업 심의위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of the Private Investment Project Review Committee for Military Facilities

rows.source_ko: 8. 시설건설 중기계획 및 예산편성 검토ㆍ조정ㆍ종합 및 요구
rows.text_en: 8. Review, adjustment, comprehensive review, and request for medium-term facility construction plans and budget formulation

rows.source_ko: 9. 군 시설업무의 정보화체계 구축ㆍ운영 및 유지 계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment of a plan for the construction, operation, and maintenance of the informatization system for military facility operations

rows.source_ko: 10. 전력지원시설사업의 추진전략 수립
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment of Promotion Strategy for Power Support Facility Projects

rows.source_ko: 11. 전력지원시설사업의 중기계획 수립
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment of a Mid-term Plan for Power Support Facility Projects

rows.source_ko: 12. 전력지원시설사업의 예산 편성ㆍ운영 및 결산
rows.text_en: 12. Budgeting, Operation, and Settlement of Accounts for Power Support Facility Projects

rows.source_ko: 13. 전력지원시설사업의 집행관리
rows.text_en: 13. Execution Management of Power Support Facility Projects

rows.source_ko: 14. 전력지원시설사업의 대국민ㆍ대국회 홍보
rows.text_en: 14. Public and National Assembly Promotion of the Power Support Facility Project

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 부대건설과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Unit Construction Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「국방ㆍ군사시설이전 특별회계법」에 따른 국방ㆍ군사시설이전 특별회계의 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Operation and management of the Special Account for the Relocation of National Defense and Military Facilities pursuant to the Special Account for the Relocation of National Defense and Military Facilities Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방ㆍ군사시설이전사업(부대이전시설사업 및 부대개편시설사업을 말한다. 이하 같다)의 추진전략 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of implementation strategies for defense and military facility relocation projects (referring to unit relocation facility projects and unit reorganization facility projects; hereinafter the same applies).

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방ㆍ군사시설이전사업의 중기계획 수립
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment of a Mid-term Plan for the Relocation of National Defense and Military Facilities

rows.source_ko: 4. 국방ㆍ군사시설이전사업의 예산 편성ㆍ운영 및 결산
rows.text_en: 4. Budgeting, Operation, and Settlement of Accounts for National Defense and Military Facility Relocation Projects

rows.source_ko: 5. 국방ㆍ군사시설이전사업의 집행관리
rows.text_en: 5. Execution Management of National Defense and Military Facility Relocation Projects

rows.source_ko: 6. 국방ㆍ군사시설이전사업의 대국민ㆍ대국회 홍보
rows.text_en: 6. Public and National Assembly Promotion of the National Defense and Military Facilities Relocation Project

rows.source_ko: 7. 공익사업 시행에 따른 군사시설 이전 협의 및 정책수립에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning consultation on the relocation of military facilities and policy formulation due to the implementation of public interest projects

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 국유재산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the State Property Division shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방부 소관 국유재산(「군수품관리법」의 적용을 받는 재산은 제외한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)의 관리계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of management plans for state-owned property under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of National Defense ( excluding property subject to the Military Supplies Management Act; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 2. 국유재산의 취득ㆍ처분에 관한 계획의 수립 및 관계부처와의 협의
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of plans regarding the acquisition and disposal of state-owned property and consultation with relevant ministries

rows.source_ko: 3. 부동산ㆍ권리의 징발 및 보상 수행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the execution of requisition and compensation for real estate and rights

rows.source_ko: 4. 국방부 소관 국유재산의 현황관리
rows.text_en: 4. Status Management of State-Owned Property under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of National Defense

rows.source_ko: 5. 외부관리 위탁재산 운용 및 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Operation and Management of Assets Entrusted to External Management

rows.source_ko: 6. 국방부 소관 유휴 국유재산 가치향상 정책 연구, 국방부 소관 국유재산 개발 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning policy research on enhancing the value of idle state-owned property under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of National Defense, and the development of state-owned property under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of National Defense, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 군주거정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Military Housing Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 군 주거지원 정책 수립 및 법령 정비
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of military housing support policies and revision of relevant laws

rows.source_ko: 2. 군 주거시설 소요 검증 및 확보 계획 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Verification of military housing requirements and establishment of a plan for securing them

rows.source_ko: 3. 군 주거시설의 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Operation and Management of Military Housing Facilities

rows.source_ko: 4. 주거시설 입주대상 자격 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of Eligibility for Occupancy in Residential Facilities

rows.source_ko: 5. 민간주택임대자금 지원에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning support for private housing rental funds

rows.source_ko: 6. 주거지원 관련 군인복지기금 운영ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 6. Operation and Management of the Military Welfare Fund Related to Housing Support

rows.source_ko: 7. 무주택 군인 대상 주택공급에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the supply of housing to homeless military personnel

rows.source_ko: 8. 군 주거시설 사업의 중기계획 및 예산편성 검토ㆍ조정ㆍ종합 및 요구에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the review, adjustment, consolidation, and requests for the medium-term plan and budget formulation of military housing facility projects

rows.source_ko: 9. 군 관사ㆍ간부숙소 등 주거시설 신축ㆍ보수에 관한 사업집행 관리
rows.text_en: 9. Management of project execution regarding the new construction and repair of residential facilities, such as military quarters and officers' quarters

rows.source_ko: 10. 군 주거시설 관리에 관한 전문성 제고 방안 마련ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 10. Development and implementation of measures to enhance expertise in the management of military housing facilities

rows.source_ko: 11. 군 주거지원 관련 정보화체계 구축ㆍ운영 및 유지
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment, operation, and maintenance of an information system related to military housing support

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 환경소음팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Environmental Noise Team Leader is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 군 환경정책 및 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of county environmental policies and plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방ㆍ군사시설사업에 대한 환경영향평가 협의 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Consultation on Environmental Impact Assessment for National Defense and Military Facility Projects

rows.source_ko: 3. 군 폐기물의 배출 및 처리 정책 수립
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment of policies for the discharge and treatment of military waste

rows.source_ko: 4. 자연보호 및 생태계보전활동 정책 수립
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of policies for nature conservation and ecosystem preservation activities

rows.source_ko: 5. 군 유해환경작업장 시설 및 환경 개선 정책 수립
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of policies for the improvement of facilities and environments in military hazardous workplaces

rows.source_ko: 6. 환경보전시설의 설치ㆍ계획 수립 및 관련 예산 검토ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Installation and planning of environmental conservation facilities, and review and adjustment of related budgets

rows.source_ko: 7. 소음 방지 및 피해 보상에 관한 법령ㆍ제도 정비
rows.text_en: 7. Improvement of laws and systems regarding noise prevention and damage compensation

rows.source_ko: 8. 소음영향도의 조사 및 조사 기준 수립ㆍ운용에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 8. Duties regarding the investigation of noise impact levels and the establishment and operation of investigation standards

rows.source_ko: 9. 소음ㆍ진동 관련 정책 수립 및 피해보상 등에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the establishment of policies related to noise and vibration and compensation for damages, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 군용비행장 및 군사격장 소음피해 대책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment and implementation of measures to mitigate noise damage from military airfields and military firing ranges

rows.source_ko: 11. 소음방지 및 피해보상 기본계획과 시행계획 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment and Coordination of Basic and Implementation Plans for Noise Prevention and Damage Compensation

rows.source_ko: 12.「군용비행장ㆍ군사격장 소음 방지 및 피해 보상에 관한 법률」에 따른 소음대책지역의 지정 및 관리
rows.text_en: 12. Designation and management of noise control areas pursuant to the Act on Prevention of Noise and Compensation for Damages from Military Airfields and Military Firing Ranges

rows.source_ko: 13. 중앙소음대책심의위원회의 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning the operation of the Central Noise Countermeasures Deliberation Committee

rows.source_ko: 14. 자동소음측정망 설치 및 소음관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 14. Tasks related to the installation of automatic noise measurement networks and noise management

rows.source_ko: 15. 소음피해 보상금의 편성ㆍ운용ㆍ결산 및 검사 등에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 15. Duties concerning the compilation, operation, settlement, and inspection of noise damage compensation funds

rows.source_ko: 16. 주민 보상 관련 정부ㆍ지방자치단체 등의 협의 및 민원 업무
rows.text_en: 16. Consultation with the government, local governments, etc., and civil complaint handling regarding resident compensation

rows.source_ko: 17. 주한미군지위협정에 따른 소음저감분과위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 17. Operation of the Noise Reduction Subcommittee under the Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA)

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 지뢰대응활동팀장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 10. The Mine Response Team Leader is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 지뢰대응활동 추진전략 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and Implementation of Mine Response Activity Strategy

rows.source_ko: 2. 지뢰대응활동위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Operation of the Mine Response Activities Committee

rows.source_ko: 3. 지뢰대응활동에 관한 기본계획 및 연도별 시행계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and coordination of the basic plan and annual implementation plan regarding landmine response activities

rows.source_ko: 4. 지뢰대응활동 관련 정책 수립 및 제도ㆍ교육 발전
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of policies and development of systems and education related to landmine response activities

rows.source_ko: 5. 지뢰대응활동 관련 법령의 제정ㆍ개정 및 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Enactment, Amendment, and Operation of Laws Related to Mine Countermeasure Activities

rows.source_ko: 6. 지뢰대응활동표준의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and Adjustment of Mine Response Activity Standards

rows.source_ko: 7. 지뢰대응활동 관련 중기계획 및 예산편성의 검토ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Review and adjustment of mid-term plans and budget formulation related to landmine response activities

rows.source_ko: 8. 「지뢰의 제거 등 지뢰대응활동에 관한 법률」에 따른 지뢰제거자에 대한 관리ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 8. Management and supervision of mine removers pursuant to the Act on Mine Removal and Counter-Mine Activities

rows.source_ko: 9. 지뢰대응활동 관련 국제기구, 지역기구 및 단체 등과의 협력
rows.text_en: 9. Cooperation with international organizations, regional organizations, and groups regarding landmine response activities

rows.source_ko: 10. 지뢰정보관리체계 구축 및 운영에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 10. Tasks regarding the establishment and operation of the mine information management system

rows.source_ko: 11. 지뢰대응활동 관련 관계 중앙행정기관과 지방자치단체 등과의 협의 및 민원 업무
rows.text_en: 11. Consultation with relevant central administrative agencies and local governments, and civil affairs regarding landmine response activities

rows.source_ko: 12. 지뢰의 탐지ㆍ제거를 위한 타인 토지에의 출입 등 행위로 인한 손실보상에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning compensation for losses resulting from acts such as entering others' land for the detection and removal of landmines

rows.source_ko: 13. 지뢰피해자 지원에 관한 법령 및 제도의 운영ㆍ개선
rows.text_en: 13. Operation and Improvement of Laws and Systems Concerning Support for Landmine Victims

rows.source_ko: 14. 그 밖에 지뢰대응활동에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Other matters concerning landmine response activities

Article 12 Deleted <July 24, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제4장 국방홍보원
rows.text_en: Chapter 4 Defense Public Relations Agency

rows.source_ko: 제13조(국방홍보원장) ① 국방홍보원에 원장 1명을 두되, 원장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 임기제공무원으로 보하고, 그 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2016. 3. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Director of the Defense Public Relations Agency) ① One Director shall be appointed to the Defense Public Relations Agency; the Director shall be appointed as a fixed-term public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade thereof shall be Grade B. <Amended Mar. 22, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ② 원장은 국방부장관의 명을 받아 소관사무를 총괄하고, 소속 공무원을 지휘ㆍ감독한다. <개정 2016. 3. 22.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director shall oversee affairs under his/her jurisdiction and direct and supervise officials under his/her jurisdiction upon the order of the Minister of National Defense. <Amended Mar. 22, 2016>
[Title amended Mar. 22, 2016]
Article 14 Deleted <Mar. 22, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제5장 국방전산정보원 <개정 2009. 5. 26.>
rows.text_en: Chapter 5 Defense Computer Information Center <Amended May 26, 2009>

rows.source_ko: 제15조(국방전산정보원장) ① 국방전산정보원에 원장 1명을 두되, 원장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 임기제공무원으로 보하고, 그 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Director of the Defense Computer Information Agency) ① One Director shall be appointed to the Defense Computer Information Agency, and the Director shall be appointed as a fixed-term public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 원장은 국방부장관의 명을 받아 소관사무를 총괄하고, 소속 공무원을 지휘ㆍ감독한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Director shall oversee affairs under the jurisdiction of the Minister of National Defense and direct and supervise officials under his/her jurisdiction.
[Wholly Amended Mar. 22, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제6장 공무원의 정원 등
rows.text_en: Chapter 6. Staffing Levels of Public Officials, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제16조(국방부에 두는 공무원의 정원 등) ① 국방부에 두는 공무원(군인은 제외한다)의 정원(「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따른 한시정원은 제외한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)은 별표 1과 같다. 다만, 「국방부와 그 소속기관 직제」 제25조제1항 단서에 따라 별표 1에 따른 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 1의2와 같으며, 별표 1의2의 정원 중 3명(4급 또는 5급 1명, 5급 2명)은 일반임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <개정 2018. 3. 30., 2018. 12. 24., 2021. 3. 30., 2023. 7. 25., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 7. 24., 2024. 11. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Personnel Quotas, etc. for Public Officials in the Ministry of National Defense) ① The personnel quota for public officials (excluding military personnel) in the Ministry of National Defense ( excluding temporary personnel quotas pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies”; hereinafter the same applies in this Article) shall be as set forth in Table 1. However, the personnel quota by rank for public officials, which is determined separately within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total personnel quota set forth in Table 1 pursuant to the proviso to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies ,” shall be as set forth in Table 1-2, and three of the personnel quota set forth in Table 1-2 (one person of Grade 4 or 5, and two people of Grade 5) shall be appointed as general fixed-term public officials. <Amended Mar. 30, 2018; Dec. 24, 2018; Mar. 30, 2021; July 25, 2023; August 30, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; July 24, 2024; Nov. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 국방부에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 홍보업무를 담당하는 1명(4ㆍ5급 1명) 및 그 밖의 정원 중 18명(4급 5명, 5급 3명, 6급 3명, 7급 2명, 8급 2명, 9급 3명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 12. 12., 2021. 12. 28., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Among the authorized number of public officials in the Ministry of National Defense, one person responsible for public relations (one at Grade 4 or 5) and 18 persons among the remaining authorized number (5 at Grade 4, 3 at Grade 5, 3 at Grade 6, 2 at Grade 7, 2 at Grade 8, and 3 at Grade 9) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Dec. 12, 2013; Dec. 28, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 국방부에 두는 공무원 정원 중 공공데이터 관련 업무를 담당하는 2명(5급 1명, 6급 1명), 공무를 수행하는 근로자의 인사관리 관련 업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명) 및 1959년 이전 퇴직군인 급여 관련 업무를 담당하는 2명(5급 1명, 7급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <개정 2020. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ Among the authorized number of public officials in the Ministry of National Defense, two persons responsible for public data-related duties (one at Grade 5 and one at Grade 6), one person responsible for personnel management of workers performing public duties (one at Grade 5), and two persons responsible for salary-related duties for military personnel retired prior to 1959 (one at Grade 5 and one at Grade 7) shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Feb. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 제17조(소속기관에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 삭제 <2024. 7. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Standard Quota of Public Officials in Affiliated Agencies) ① Deleted <July 24, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 국방홍보원에 두는 공무원(군인을 제외한다)의 정원은 별표 3과 같다. 이 경우 4급 공무원의 정원(3급 또는 4급 공무원 정원을 포함한다)은 4명을, 3급 또는 4급 공무원 정원은 4급 공무원의 정원(3급 또는 4급 공무원 정원을 포함한다)의 3분의 1을 각각 그 상한으로 하고, 4급 또는 5급 공무원 정원은 5급 공무원의 정원(4급 또는 5급 공무원 정원을 포함한다)의 3분의 1을 그 상한으로 한다. <개정 2014. 4. 30., 2016. 3. 22.>
rows.text_en: ② The authorized number of public officials (excluding military personnel) assigned to the Defense Public Relations Agency shall be as set forth in Attached Table 3. In this case, the authorized number of Grade 4 public officials (including the authorized number of Grade 3 or 4 public officials) shall be capped at 4, and the authorized number of Grade 3 or 4 public officials shall be capped at one-third of the authorized number of Grade 4 public officials (including the authorized number of Grade 3 or 4 public officials); and the authorized number of Grade 4 or 5 public officials shall be capped at one-third of the authorized number of Grade 5 public officials (including the authorized number of Grade 4 or 5 public officials). <Amended Apr. 30, 2014; Mar. 22, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ③ 국방전산정보원에 두는 공무원(군인을 제외한다)의 정원은 별표 4와 같다. 이 경우 4급 공무원의 정원(3급 또는 4급 공무원 정원을 포함한다)은 2명을, 3급 또는 4급 공무원 정원은 4급 공무원의 정원(3급 또는 4급 공무원 정원을 포함한다)의 3분의 1을 각각 그 상한으로 하고, 4급 또는 5급 공무원 정원은 5급 공무원의 정원(4급 또는 5급 공무원 정원을 포함한다)의 3분의 1을 그 상한으로 한다. <개정 2009. 5. 26., 2016. 3. 22.>
rows.text_en: ③ The authorized number of public officials (excluding military personnel) assigned to the Defense Computer Information Agency shall be as set forth in Attached Table 4. In this case, the authorized number of Grade 4 public officials (including the authorized number of Grade 3 or 4 public officials) shall be capped at 2, and the authorized number of Grade 3 or 4 public officials shall be capped at one-third of the authorized number of Grade 4 public officials (including the authorized number of Grade 3 or 4 public officials); and the authorized number of Grade 4 or 5 public officials shall be capped at one-third of the authorized number of Grade 5 public officials (including the authorized number of Grade 4 or 5 public officials). <Amended May 26, 2009; March 22, 2016>
Article 17-2 Deleted <December 24, 2018>
Article 18 Deleted <Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제6장의2 평가대상 조직 <신설 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Chapter 6-2 Organizations Subject to Evaluation <Newly Inserted Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제18조의2(평가대상 조직) 국방부에 두는 평가대상 조직의 구체적인 사항은 별표 5의2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 18-2 (Organizations Subject to Evaluation) Specific details regarding organizations subject to evaluation within the Ministry of National Defenseare as set forth in Attached Table 5-2.
[This Article Newly Inserted Jan. 2, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제7장 한시조직 및 정원 <개정 2012. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Chapter 7 Temporary Organizations and Personnel Quotas <Amended Jul. 26, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제19조(핵추진잠수함정책기획단) ① 핵추진잠수함정책기획단장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Nuclear-Powered Submarine Policy Planning Group) ① The Head of the Nuclear-Powered Submarine Policy Planning Group shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 핵추진잠수함정책기획단장 밑에 정책소통담당관, 국제협력담당관 및 국방원자력안전담당관 각 1명을 두되, 정책소통담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 국제협력담당관은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 국방원자력안전담당관은 영관급 장교로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② One policy communication officer, one international cooperation officer, and one national defense nuclear safety officer shall be appointed under the head of the Nuclear Powered Submarine Policy Planning Group. The policy communication officer shall be appointed as a deputy director, science and technology secretary, or secretary; the international cooperation officer shall be appointed as a science and technology secretary or secretary; and the national defense nuclear safety officer shall be appointed as a field-grade officer.

rows.source_ko: ③ 정책소통담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 핵추진잠수함정책기획단장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Policy Communication Officer assists the Director of the Nuclear Powered Submarine Policy Planning Group with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 핵추진잠수함(핵추진잠수함 원자력안전에 관한 사항은 제외한다) 관련 정책의 수립ㆍ추진 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, implementation, and coordination of policies related to nuclear-powered submarines (excluding matters concerning the nuclear safety of nuclear-powered submarines)

rows.source_ko: 2. 핵추진잠수함(핵추진잠수함 원자력안전에 관한 사항은 제외한다) 관련 법령ㆍ제도의 운영ㆍ개선
rows.text_en: 2. Operation and improvement of laws and systems related to nuclear-powered submarines (excluding matters concerning nuclear safety of nuclear-powered submarines)

rows.source_ko: 3. 핵추진잠수함 소요 업무(소요결정에 관한 업무는 제외한다)에 관한 조정
rows.text_en: 3. Coordination regarding nuclear-powered submarine requirements (excluding tasks related to the determination of requirements)

rows.source_ko: 4. 핵추진잠수함 획득(연구개발ㆍ생산하여 조달하는 것을 말한다) 및 운영 관련 정책의 조정 및 가용재원 판단ㆍ배분
rows.text_en: 4. Coordination of policies related to the acquisition (referring to procurement through research, development, and production) and operation of nuclear-powered submarines, and assessment and allocation of available resources

rows.source_ko: 5. 핵추진잠수함 관련 소요결정에 관한 업무 협조 및 국방중기계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 5. Coordination regarding the determination of requirements for nuclear-powered submarines and establishment of the Mid-term National Defense Plan

rows.source_ko: 6. 핵추진잠수함의 시험평가 및 분석ㆍ평가(국방부 소관 사항에 한정한다) 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Tasks related to the test evaluation and analysis/assessment of nuclear-powered submarines (limited to matters under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of National Defense)

rows.source_ko: 7. 핵추진잠수함(핵추진잠수함 원자력안전에 관한 사항은 제외한다) 관련 관계기관 협력 및 협의체의 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Cooperation with relevant agencies and operation of consultative bodies regarding nuclear-powered submarines (excluding matters concerning nuclear safety of nuclear-powered submarines)

rows.source_ko: 8. 핵추진잠수함 관련 전문인력의 확보ㆍ관리를 위한 정책 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment and coordination of policies for securing and managing specialized personnel related to nuclear-powered submarines

rows.source_ko: 9. 핵추진잠수함 관련 정책 소통ㆍ홍보
rows.text_en: 9. Communication and Promotion of Policies Related to Nuclear-Powered Submarines

rows.source_ko: 10. 핵추진잠수함 관련 갈등관리 및 수용성에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning conflict management and acceptance regarding nuclear-powered submarines

rows.source_ko: 11. 그 밖에 기획단 내 다른 담당관의 업무에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters not falling under the duties of other officers within the Planning Team

rows.source_ko: ④ 국제협력담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 핵추진잠수함정책기획단장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The International Cooperation Officer assists the Director of the Nuclear Powered Submarine Policy Planning Group with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 핵추진잠수함 관련 외국(외국의 법인이나 단체를 포함한다)과의 국방분야 협력 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of defense cooperation with foreign countries (including foreign corporations or organizations) regarding nuclear-powered submarines

rows.source_ko: 2. 핵추진잠수함 관련 국제기구와의 국방분야(핵비확산에 관한 업무에 한정한다) 협력
rows.text_en: 2. Cooperation in the defense sector with international organizations regarding nuclear-powered submarines (limited to matters concerning nuclear non-proliferation)

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방부 소관 핵추진잠수함 관련 협정 등의 체결지원 및 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Support for and management of agreements, etc. related to nuclear-powered submarines under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of National Defense

rows.source_ko: 4. 핵추진잠수함 관련 대외 정책ㆍ정세 분석
rows.text_en: 4. Analysis of Foreign Policy and Situation Regarding Nuclear-Powered Submarines

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 국방원자력안전담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 핵추진잠수함정책기획단장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Defense Nuclear Safety Officer assists the Director of the Nuclear Power Submarine Policy Planning Group with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 핵추진잠수함 원자력안전 관련 정책의 수립ㆍ추진
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and Promotion of Policies Related to Nuclear Safety for Nuclear-Powered Submarines

rows.source_ko: 2. 핵추진잠수함 원자력안전 관련 법령ㆍ제도의 수립 및 연구ㆍ발전
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of laws and systems related to nuclear safety for nuclear-powered submarines and research and development

rows.source_ko: 3. 핵추진잠수함 관련 원자력 안전규제 및 안전조치 체계 구축
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment of a Nuclear Safety Regulation and Safeguards System for Nuclear-Powered Submarines

rows.source_ko: 4. 핵추진잠수함 관련 핵비확산 및 안전조치에 관한 협정 등의 이행
rows.text_en: 4. Implementation of Agreements on Nuclear Non-Proliferation and Safeguards, etc., regarding nuclear-powered submarines

rows.source_ko: 5. 핵추진잠수함 원자력안전 관련 관계기관 협력 및 협의체의 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Cooperation among relevant agencies and operation of the consultative body regarding nuclear safety of nuclear-powered submarines

rows.source_ko: 6. 핵추진잠수함 원자력안전 관련 전문기관의 확보ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 6. Securing and operation of specialized agencies related to nuclear safety for nuclear-powered submarines

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 핵추진잠수함정책기획단장 밑에 두는 공무원의 한시정원의 직급별 정원은 별표 6과 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The number of temporary public officials by rank under the Head of the Nuclear Powered Submarine Policy Planning Group is as shown in Attached Table 6.
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 14, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제20조(군공항이전사업단) ① 군공항이전사업단장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Military Airport Relocation Project Group) ① The Head of the Military Airport Relocation Project Group shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 군공항이전사업단장 밑에 이전총괄과장, 이전사업과장 및 이전계획과장 각 1명을 두되, 이전총괄과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 이전사업과장은 영관급장교로, 이전계획과장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2020. 1. 29., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② One Head of the Relocation Management Division, one Head of the Relocation Project Division, and one Head of the Relocation Planning Division shall be appointed under the Head of the Military Airport Relocation Project Group; provided that the Head of the Relocation Management Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, or Secretary; the Head of the Relocation Project Division as a Field-grade officer; and the Head of the Relocation Planning Division as a Secretary of Science and Technology or Secretary. <Amended Jan. 29, 2020; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 이전총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2020. 1. 29.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Relocation General Affairs Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 군공항이전사업단 업무 총괄 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of the Military Airport Relocation Project Group

rows.source_ko: 2. 군 공항 이전 관련 법령의 제정ㆍ개정 등 제도 개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning institutional improvements, such as the enactment and amendment of laws related to the relocation of military airports

rows.source_ko: 3. 군 공항 이전 및 지원사업 관련 위원회 운영 및 관리 총괄
rows.text_en: 3. Overall management of the committee related to the military airport relocation and support projects

rows.source_ko: 4. 군 공항 이전 및 지원사업의 갈등관리 및 홍보 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management of conflict management and public relations for military airport relocation and support projects

rows.source_ko: 5. 군 공항에 주둔하는 외국군대의 이전에 관한 협상 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of negotiations regarding the relocation of foreign troops stationed at military airports

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 군공항이전사업단 내 다른 과의 업무에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters not falling under the duties of other divisions within the Military Airport Relocation Project Group

rows.source_ko: ④ 이전사업과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2020. 1. 29.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Relocation Project Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 대구 군공항 이전 및 지원사업 관련 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of tasks related to the relocation and support projects for Daegu Military Airport

rows.source_ko: 2. 대구 군공항 이전사업 관련 사업계획 및 실시계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of Business Plan and Implementation Plan Related to the Daegu Military Airport Relocation Project

rows.source_ko: 3. 대구 군공항에 주둔하는 외국군대의 이전 관련 협상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning negotiations regarding the relocation of foreign troops stationed at Daegu Military Airport

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 이전계획과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2020. 1. 29.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Relocation Planning Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jan. 29, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 수원 군공항 이전 및 지원사업 관련 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of tasks related to the relocation and support projects for Suwon Military Airport

rows.source_ko: 2. 수원 군공항 이전사업 관련 사업계획 및 실시계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of Business Plan and Implementation Plan Related to the Suwon Military Airport Relocation Project

rows.source_ko: 3. 수원 군공항에 주둔하는 외국군대의 이전 관련 협상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning negotiations regarding the relocation of foreign troops stationed at Suwon Military Airport

rows.source_ko: 4. 광주 군공항 이전 및 지원사업 관련 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management of tasks related to the relocation and support projects for Gwangju Military Airport

rows.source_ko: 5. 광주 군공항 이전사업 관련 사업계획 및 실시계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of business plan and implementation plan related to the Gwangju Military Airport relocation project

rows.source_ko: 6. 광주 군공항에 주둔하는 외국군대의 이전 관련 협상에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning negotiations regarding the relocation of foreign troops stationed at Gwangju Military Airport

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 군공항이전사업단에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 6과 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The authorized number of public officials by rank in the Military Airport Relocation Project Group is as shown in Attached Table 6.
[Wholly Amended Jan. 31, 2017]

rows.source_ko: 제20조의2(군인권개선추진단장) ① 군인권개선추진단장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하며, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20-2 (Head of the Task Force for the Improvement of Military Human Rights) ① The Head of the Task Force for the Improvement of Military Human Rights shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 군인권개선추진단장 밑에 군인권총괄담당관ㆍ성폭력예방대응담당관ㆍ병영문화혁신담당관 및 양성평등정책팀장 각 1명을 두며, 군인권총괄담당관 및 성폭력예방대응담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 병영문화혁신담당관은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로, 양성평등정책팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ임업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ환경사무관ㆍ항공사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ방송통신사무관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 사서사무관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Under the Head of the Task Force for the Improvement of Military Human Rights, one Officer for General Affairs of Military Human Rights, one Officer for Prevention and Response to Sexual Violence, one Officer for Innovation in Barracks Culture, and one Team Leader for Gender Equality Policy shall be appointed. The Officer for General Affairs of Military Human Rights and the Officer for Prevention and Response to Sexual Violence shall be appointed as Deputy Director General, Secretary of Science and Technology, or Secretary; the Officer for Innovation in Barracks Culture shall be appointed as Secretary of Science and Technology or Secretary; and the Team Leader for Gender Equality Policy shall be appointed as Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Officer, Forestry Officer, Health Officer, Environment Officer, Aviation Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Broadcasting and Telecommunications Officer, Administrative Officer, or Library Officer. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 군인권총괄담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 군인권개선추진단장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Officer in Charge of Military Human Rights assists the Head of the Military Human Rights Improvement Task Force with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 군내 인권정책에 대한 종합계획의 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of a comprehensive plan for human rights policies within the military

rows.source_ko: 2. 군내 인권실태의 점검 및 인권침해 사건의 조사ㆍ구제
rows.text_en: 2. Inspection of human rights conditions within the military and investigation and redress of human rights violations

rows.source_ko: 3. 군내 인권 관련 법령ㆍ제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning laws and systems related to human rights within the military

rows.source_ko: 4. 군내 인권 관련 국제협약에의 가입 및 국내시행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning accession to and domestic implementation of international conventions related to human rights within the military

rows.source_ko: 5. 군내 인권상담 및 인권지키미 운영 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning human rights counseling and the operation and management of human rights guardians within the military

rows.source_ko: 6. 군 인권교육에 대한 종합계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and implementation of a comprehensive plan for military human rights education

rows.source_ko: 7. 군 인권교육 컨텐츠의 개발ㆍ관리 및 과정에 대한 분석ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 7. Development and Management of Military Human Rights Education Content and Analysis and Evaluation of the Process

rows.source_ko: 8. 국가인권위원회의 권고사항 이행 및 인권침해사건 조사 등 업무 협조
rows.text_en: 8. Cooperation with the National Human Rights Commission of Korea regarding the implementation of recommendations and investigation of human rights violations.

rows.source_ko: 9. 장병인권 관련 민간기관 등과의 협력ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 9. Cooperation and support with civilian organizations, etc. regarding the human rights of soldiers

rows.source_ko: 10. 주요 군과거사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning major military history

rows.source_ko: 11. 그 밖에 장병인권 업무의 발전을 위한 제도개선 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters concerning institutional improvements, etc. for the development of personnel human rights affairs

rows.source_ko: ④ 성폭력예방대응담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 군인권개선추진단장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Sexual Violence Prevention and Response Officer assists the Head of the Military Human Rights Improvement Promotion Team with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방 분야 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 예방 정책의 수립ㆍ점검
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and monitoring of policies for the prevention of sexual harassment and sexual violence in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 성폭력 예방 및 피해자 보호에 관한 법령의 관리 및 제도개선
rows.text_en: 2. Management of laws and regulations regarding the prevention of sexual violence and protection of victims, and improvement of the system

rows.source_ko: 3. 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 피해자 보호를 위한 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and implementation of plans for the protection of victims of sexual harassment and sexual violence

rows.source_ko: 4. 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 피해자 통합지원체계의 운영 총괄 및 개선
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management and improvement of the integrated support system for victims of sexual harassment and sexual violence

rows.source_ko: 5. 국방분야 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 사건의 DB구축 및 분석
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and Analysis of Databases on Sexual Harassment and Sexual Violence Cases in the Defense Sector

rows.source_ko: 6. 군내 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 실태에 관한 조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 6. Survey and Research on the Status of Sexual Harassment and Sexual Violence within the Military

rows.source_ko: 7. 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 피해 신고 문화 조성을 위한 정책 및 홍보 시행
rows.text_en: 7. Implementation of policies and public awareness campaigns to foster a culture of reporting sexual harassment and sexual violence

rows.source_ko: 8. 피해자 보호 및 지원 강화를 위한 대ㆍ내외 협력체계 구축
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment of an internal and external cooperation system to strengthen victim protection and support

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 병영문화혁신담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 군인권개선추진단장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Officer for Innovation in Military Culture assists the Head of the Task Force for the Improvement of Military Human Rights with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 병영문화 발전을 위한 종합대책의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of comprehensive measures for the development of military barracks culture

rows.source_ko: 2. 병영문화 발전을 위한 제도 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on Institutions for the Development of Military Culture

rows.source_ko: 3. 병영문화 개선에 대한 추진과제 발굴 및 진행상태 확인
rows.text_en: 3. Identification of tasks for improving military barracks culture and verification of progress status

rows.source_ko: 4. 병영문화 개선에 관한 관련 기관 협의
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation with relevant agencies regarding the improvement of military barracks culture

rows.source_ko: 5. 군인복무 관련 법령 및 제도에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning laws and systems related to military service

rows.source_ko: 6. 군기강 확립 및 군기(軍紀) 사고예방에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Duties regarding the establishment of military discipline and the prevention of military accidents

rows.source_ko: 7. 장교ㆍ준사관 및 부사관의 고충처리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the handling of grievances of officers, warrant officers, and non-commissioned officers

rows.source_ko: 8. 국방부조사본부 업무(군기사고예방에 관한 업무로 한정한다)의 지도ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 8. Guidance and supervision of the duties of the Ministry of National Defense Investigation Headquarters (limited to duties related to the prevention of military discipline accidents)

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 양성평등정책팀장은 다음 사항에 관하여 군인권개선추진단장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Gender Equality Policy Team Leader assists the Head of the Military Human Rights Improvement Promotion Team with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국방 분야 양성평등 관련 정책 및 계획의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of policies and plans related to gender equality in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 국방 분야 성 주류화(性 主流化) 제도의 운영 및 성차별적 정책의 모니터링ㆍ개선
rows.text_en: 2. Operation of Gender Mainstreaming Systems in the Defense Sector and Monitoring and Improvement of Gender-Discriminatory Policies

rows.source_ko: 3. 국방 분야 양성평등 문화의 확산 및 점검에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the dissemination and monitoring of a gender equality culture in the defense sector

rows.source_ko: 4. 성인지ㆍ양성평등 및 성희롱ㆍ성폭력 예방 교육에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning education on gender sensitivity, gender equality, and prevention of sexual harassment and sexual violence

rows.source_ko: 5. 양성평등정책 및 성인지 교육 관련 대ㆍ내외 협의에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning internal and external consultations regarding gender equality policies and gender sensitivity education

rows.source_ko: 6. 외국의 여군 관련 정책 분석 및 교류 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Analysis of foreign policies regarding female soldiers and exchange activities

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 군인권개선추진단장 밑에 두는 공무원의 한시정원의 직급별 정원은 별표 6과 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The number of temporary public officials by rank under the Head of the Military Human Rights Improvement Promotion Team is as shown in Attached Table 6.
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 22, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제20조의3(방위산업수출기획과) ① 방위산업수출기획과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 20-3 (Defense Industry Export Planning Division) ① The Head of the Defense Industry Export Planning Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, a Science and Technology Secretary, or a Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 방위산업수출기획과에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 6과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The authorized number of public officials by rank in the Defense Industry Export Planning Division is as shown in Attached Table 6.
[This Article Newly Inserted on Apr. 18, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제20조의4(중동아프리카정책과) ① 중동아프리카정책과장은 영관급장교로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20-4 (Middle East and Africa Policy Division) ① The Head of the Middle East and Africa Policy Division shall be appointed as a field-grade officer.

rows.source_ko: ② 중동아프리카정책과에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 6과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The number of public officials by rank in the Middle East and Africa Policy Division is as shown in Attached Table 6.
[This Article Newly Inserted July 25, 2023]
Article 20-5 Deleted <January 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제20조의6(국방연구개발기획과) ① 국방연구개발기획과장은 과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 20-6 (Defense Research and Development Planning Division) ① The Head of the Defense Research and Development Planning Division shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary for Science and Technology or a Senior Secretary. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 국방연구개발기획과에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 6과 같다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② The authorized number of public officials by rank in the Defense Research and Development Planning Division is as set forth in Attached Table 6. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>

[This Article newly inserted on July 25, 2023]
[Title amended on January 2, 2026]
Article 20-7 Deleted <January 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제21조(한시정원) ① 1959년 이전 퇴직군인 급여 관련 업무를 추진하기 위하여 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따라 2026년 12월 31일까지 별표 7에 따른 한시정원을 국방부에 둔다. <개정 2022. 2. 22., 2025. 5. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Temporary Staffing) ① In order to carry out duties related to the salaries of military personnel retired prior to 1959, a temporary staffing quota set forth in Annex 7 shall be established within the Ministry of National Defense until December 31, 2026, pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies. <Amended Feb. 22, 2022; May 20, 2025>
② Deleted <January 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 미등재 건축물 양성화 사업 업무를 추진하기 위하여 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따라 2028년 3월 31일까지 별표 7에 따른 한시정원을 국방부에 둔다. <신설 2021. 3. 30., 2023. 12. 12., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ③ In order to carry out the project for the legalization of unregistered buildings, a temporary staffing quota set forth in Annex 7 shall be established within the Ministry of National Defense until March 31, 2028, pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies. <Newly added Mar. 30, 2021; Dec. 12, 2023; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ④ 국군의무사관학교 설립ㆍ운영 관련 업무를 추진하기 위하여 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따라 2028년 12월 31일까지 별표 7에 따른 한시정원을 국방부에 둔다. <신설 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ④ In order to carry out tasks related to the establishment and operation of the Armed Forces Medical Officer School, a temporary quota set forth in Annex 7 shall be established within the Ministry of National Defense until December 31, 2028, pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies. <Newly Inserted Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 미래국방전략위원회의 운영 지원 관련 업무를 수행하기 위하여 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따라 2028년 8월 31일까지 별표 7에 따른 한시정원을 국방부에 둔다. <신설 2026. 8. 28.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ In order to perform duties related to operational support for the Future National Defense Strategy Committee, temporary personnel quotas set forth in Annex 7 shall be established within the Ministry of National Defense until August 31, 2028, pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies. <Newly added Aug. 28, 2026>
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 25, 2020]
ADDENDA <Ministry of National Defense Decree No. 646, Mar. 4, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 감축되는 공무원의 정원 8명(4급 또는 5급 1명, 5급 2명, 6급 1명, 7급 1명, 기능10급 3명)에 해당하는 초과현원이 있는 경우에는 현원이 이 규칙에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그 초과현원에 상응하는 정원이 국방부와 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas)  In the event that there is an excess of personnel corresponding to the 8 personnel quota (1 person of Grade 4 or 5, 2 people of Grade 5, 1 person of Grade 6, 1 person of Grade 7, and 3 people of Technical Grade 10) that is reduced by the enforcement of this Rule, the personnel quota corresponding to such excess personnel shall be deemed to exist separately within the Ministry of National Defense and its affiliated organizations until the personnel quota matches the personnel quota under this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(다른 법령의 개정) ① 국방대학교학생선발및수업료징수에관한규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① The Rules on Student Selection and Tuition Collection at the National Defense University are partially amended as follows:

rows.source_ko: 제2조제2항제2호가목 중 “행정자치부장관”을 “행정안전부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 2, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2, Item (a), “Minister of Government Administration and Home Affairs” shall be changed to “Minister of Public Administration and Security.”

rows.source_ko: ② 국방부장관의 소속청장 지휘에 관한 규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ② Part of the Rules on the Command of Agency Heads by the Minister of National Defense is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제4조제2항 중 “인사복지본부장”을 “인사복지실장”으로, “자원관리본부장”을 “전력자원관리실장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 4, Paragraph 2, “Head of Personnel and Welfare Headquarters” shall be changed to “Head of Personnel and Welfare Office,” and “Head of Resource Management Headquarters” shall be changed to “Head of Electricity Resource Management Office.”

rows.source_ko: 제2조(사무직렬 기능직공무원 정원 조정에 따른 특례) 이 규칙에 따라 증원되는 국방부 일반직공무원 정원 18명(행정서기 17명, 행정서기보 1명)과 국방부 소속기관 일반직공무원 정원 2명(행정서기 2명)은 대통령령 제21717호 공무원임용령 일부개정령 부칙 제2조에 따라 충원하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special provisions regarding the adjustment of the quota for functional civil servants in the administrative series)  The 18 general civil servant positions in the Ministry of National Defense (17 administrative clerks and 1 assistant administrative clerk) and the 2 general civil servant positions in agencies affiliated with the Ministry of National Defense (2 administrative clerks) that are increased pursuant to this rule shall be filled in accordance with Article 2 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Public Officials Appointment Decree, Presidential Decree No. 21717.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(사무직렬 기능직공무원의 정원 감축에 따른 경과조치) ① 이 규칙에 따라 감축되는 국방부 기능직공무원 정원 18명(기능9급 1명, 기능10급 17명)에 해당하는 기능직공무원의 초과현원이 있는 경우에는 2011년 7월 1일까지 그 초과현원에 상응하는 정원이 일반직공무원 18명(행정서기 17명, 행정서기보 1명)의 정원을 대체하여 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Following the Reduction of Quotas for Technical Civil Servants in the Administrative Series)  ① If there is an excess number of technical civil servants corresponding to the 18 quotas (1 Grade 9 Technical, 17 Grade 10 Technical) of the Ministry of National Defense technical civil servants reduced pursuant to this Rule, the quota corresponding to such excess number shall be deemed to have replaced the quota of 18 general civil servants (17 Administrative Clerks, 1 Assistant Administrative Clerk) until July 1, 2011.

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙에 따라 감축되는 국방부 소속기관 기능직공무원 정원 2명(기능10급 2명)에 해당하는 기능직공무원의 초과현원이 있는 경우에는 2011년 7월 1일까지 그 초과현원에 상응하는 정원이 일반직공무원 2명(행정서기 2명)의 정원을 대체하여 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② If there is an excess number of functional civil servants corresponding to the quota of 2 (2 Grade 10 functional civil servants) for agencies under the Ministry of National Defense that is being reduced pursuant to this rule, the quota corresponding to such excess number shall be deemed to have replaced the quota of 2 general civil servants (2 administrative clerks) until July 1, 2011.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(개방형 직위 변경에 따른 경과조치) 「공공감사에 관한 법률」 부칙 제3조제2항에 따라 제6조제1항에 따른 감사관 직위에 최초로 임용된 공무원에 이어 그 직위에 다른 공무원을 다시 임용할 때까지 종전의 제18조에 따라 인사기획관 직위에 임용된 공무원은 제18조의 개정규정에도 불구하고 계약직공무원으로 보할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures for Changes to Open Positions)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 18, public officials appointed to the position of Personnel Planning Officer pursuant to the former Article 18 may be appointed as contract officials until another public official is reappointed to the position of Auditor following the public official initially appointed to the position of Auditor pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1, in accordance with Article 3, Paragraph 2 of the Addenda to the Public Audit Act.
ADDENDA <Ministry of National Defense Decree No. 758, Mar. 5, 2012>

rows.text_en: ② If no special provisions are made regarding the matters assigned by the Head of the Facility Project Planning Team until the expiration of the period under Paragraph 1, the Head of the Facility Planning and Environment Division shall assume the responsibility from the day the expiration of the period under Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(사무직렬 기능직공무원 정원 조정에 따른 특례) 이 규칙에 따라 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 4명(행정주사보ㆍ사서주사보ㆍ공업주사보ㆍ임업주사보ㆍ보건주사보ㆍ환경주사보ㆍ항공주사보ㆍ시설주사보ㆍ전산주사보 또는 방송통신주사보 3명, 행정서기보 1명)은 대통령령 제21717호 공무원임용령 일부개정령 부칙 제2조에 따라 충원하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special provisions regarding the adjustment of the quota for functional civil servants in the administrative series)  The four general civil servant positions increased pursuant to this rule (three administrative assistants, librarian assistants, industrial assistants, forestry assistants, health assistants, environmental assistants, aviation assistants, facility assistants, computer assistants, or broadcasting and telecommunications assistants, and one administrative clerk) shall be filled in accordance with Article 2 of the Addenda to the Partial Amendment to the Public Officials Appointment Decree, Presidential Decree No. 21717.
ADDENDA <Ministry of National Defense Decree No. 811, Dec. 12, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 대통령령 제24950호 국방부와 그 소속기관 직제 일부개정령 및 대통령령 제24983호 책임운영기관의 설치ㆍ운영에 관한 법률 시행령 일부개정령 시행에 따른 초과현원으로서 이 규칙에 따른 정원을 초과하는 현원 8명(5급 3명, 6급 1명, 7급 1명, 9급 3명)은 그 초과된 현원이 이 규칙에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그에 상응하는 정원이 국방부와 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas)  As for the 8 personnel exceeding the personnel quota under this Rule due to the enforcement of Presidential Decree No. 24950, Partial Amendment to the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies, and Presidential Decree No. 24983, Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Responsible Management Agencies, the corresponding personnel quota shall be deemed to exist separately within the Ministry of National Defense and its affiliated agencies until the excess personnel quota matches the personnel quota under this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기능직 폐지에 따른 정원 조정에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 기능직공무원 정원을 감축하여 증원되는 일반직공무원 정원 중 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제26조제2항 및 제3항에 따라 통합ㆍ운영하던 정원이 있는 경우에, 그 통합ㆍ운영하던 직급에 근속승진 임용된 공무원에 대해서는 해당 직급에 재직하는 동안에는 별표 1, 별표 1의2, 별표 2부터 별표 4까지 및 별표 6의 개정규정에도 불구하고 그 정원이 국방부와 그 소속기관에 따로 있는 것으로 보고, 그에 해당하는 종전 직급의 정원은 감축된 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Adjustment of Personnel Quotas Following the Abolition of Functional Positions)  In cases where there are personnel quotas for general civil servants that were integrated and operated pursuant to Article 26, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” among the personnel quotas for general civil servants that are increased by reducing the personnel quota for functional civil servants due to the enforcement of this Rule, for civil servants appointed by promotion based on seniority to the integrated and operated ranks, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 1, Annex 1-2, Annex 2 through Annex 4, and Annex 6, such personnel quotas shall be deemed to exist separately within the Ministry of National Defense and its affiliated agencies while they are serving in the relevant ranks, and the personnel quota for the corresponding former ranks shall be deemed to have been reduced.
ADDENDA <Ministry of National Defense Decree No. 821, Apr. 30, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 양성평등정책팀장은 2028년 2월 29일까지 존속한다. <개정 2025. 5. 20., 2026. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Gender Equality Policy Team Leader newly established pursuant to Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies shall remain in existence until February 29, 2028. <Amended May 20, 2025; Feb. 27, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 종전의 국방부령 제984호 국방부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 부칙 제2조에 따라 총액인건비제로 신설한 기구로서 이 규칙 시행으로 폐지되는 병영문화혁신팀을 제외한 디지털소통팀은 2028년 5월 6일까지 존속한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26., 2026. 3. 24.>
rows.text_en: ② The Digital Communication Teams, excluding the Barracks Culture Innovation Team which is abolished by the enforcement of this Rule and was newly established under the lump-sum personnel cost system pursuant to Article 2 of the Addendum to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rule on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of National Defense and Its Affiliated Agencies (Former Ministry of National Defense Decree No. 984), shall continue to exist until May 6, 2028. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024; Mar. 24, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따른 존속기한까지 디지털소통팀장이 대변인을 보좌하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 같은 항에 따른 존속기한의 다음 날부터 디지털소통팀장이 보좌하는 사항은 정책홍보담당관이 보좌한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26.>
rows.text_en: ③ Unless special provisions are made regarding matters in which the Head of the Digital Communication Team assists the Spokesperson until the expiration date under Paragraph 2, the Policy and Public Relations Officer shall assist in such matters from the day following the expiration date under the same paragraph. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(개방형직위에 관한 경과조치) 제18조제1항의 개정규정에 따라 개방형직위에서 제외되는 직위는 제18조제1항에도 불구하고 해당 직위에 재직하는 임기제공무원의 근무기간이 만료되는 날 또는 면직 등으로 해당 직위에 결원이 발생한 날의 전날까지 임기제공무원으로 보할 수 있는 직위로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning Open Positions)  Notwithstanding Article 18, Paragraph 1, positions excluded from open positions pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 18, Paragraph 1 shall be deemed positions eligible for appointment as fixed-term public officials until the day before the expiration of the term of service of the fixed-term public official currently holding the position or the day before a vacancy occurs in the position due to dismissal, etc.
ADDENDA <Ministry of National Defense Decree No. 1090, July 15, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 소프트웨어융합팀 및 군수지능화팀은 2027년 7월 31일까지 존속한다. <개정 2025. 5. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Software Convergence Team and the Logistics Intelligence Team newly established pursuant to Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies shall remain in existence until July 31, 2027. <Amended May 20, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 소프트웨어융합팀장이 분장하는 사항 및 군수지능화팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 소프트웨어융합팀장이 분장하는 사항은 국방정보화정책과장이 분장하고, 군수지능화팀장이 분장하는 사항은 군수기획과장이 분장한다. <개정 2026. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: ② Unless special provisions are established regarding matters assigned to the Head of the Software Convergence Team and the Head of the Logistics Intelligence Team until the expiration of the term of existence under Paragraph 1, from the day following the expiration of the term of existence under Paragraph 1, the matters assigned to the Head of the Defense Information Policy Division shall be assigned, and the matters assigned to the Head of the Logistics Intelligence Team shall be assigned to the Head of the Logistics Planning Division. <Amended Feb. 27, 2026>
ADDENDA <Ministry of National Defense Decree No. 1102, Dec. 13, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 감축되는 국방홍보원의 정원 1명(9급 1명)과 국방전산정보원의 정원 1명(7급 1명)에 해당하는 초과현원이 있는 경우에는 그 초과된 현원이 이 규칙 시행에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그에 상응하는 정원이 국방홍보원과 국방전산정보원에 각각 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Personnel Quotas) If  there is an excess number of personnel corresponding to the quota of one person (Grade 9) at the Defense Public Relations Agency and one person (Grade 7) at the Defense Computer Information Agency that are reduced by the enforcement of this Rule, the corresponding quota shall be deemed to exist separately at the Defense Public Relations Agency and the Defense Computer Information Agency, respectively, until the excess number of personnel matches the quota pursuant to the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(총액인건비제로 신설한 기구의 존속기한) ① 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제29조에 따라 이 규칙 시행으로 신설되는 감염병대응팀은 2027년 12월 31일까지 존속한다. <개정 2023. 12. 12., 2025. 9. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① Infectious Disease Response Teams newly established pursuant to Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies under the enforcement of this Rule shall remain in existence until December 31, 2027. <Amended Dec. 12, 2023; Sep. 23, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 감염병대응팀장이 분장하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 감염병대응팀장이 분장하는 사항은 보건정책과장이 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② If no special provisions are made regarding the matters assigned by the Head of the Infectious Disease Response Team until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, the matters assigned by the Head of the Infectious Disease Response Team shall be assigned by the Head of the Health Policy Division from the day after the expiration date under Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(총액인건비제로 증원한 정원의 존속기한) 이 규칙 시행으로 증원되는 별표 1의2의 정원 1명(행정사무관 1명)은 2027년 12월 31일까지 존속한다. <개정 2025. 9. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Duration of Staffing Increase under the Total Personnel Cost System)  The one additional staff position (one Administrative Officer) specified in Annex 1-2, added pursuant to the enforcement of this Rule, shall remain in effect until December 31, 2027. <Amended Sep. 23, 2025>

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Organizations Newly Established Under the Total Personnel Cost System)  ① The Litigation and Appeals Team newly established pursuant to Article 29 of the General Rules on the Organization and Staffing of Administrative Agencies shall exist until March 31, 2028. <Amended Feb. 27, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 존속기한까지 송무소청팀장이 법무관리관을 보좌하는 사항에 관하여 특별한 규정을 두지 않는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 존속기한이 지난 날부터 송무소청팀장이 보좌하는 사항은 규제개혁법제담당관이 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ② If no special provisions are made regarding matters in which the Head of the Litigation and Appeals Team assists the Director of Legal Affairs until the expiration date under Paragraph 1, the Director of Regulatory Reform and Legislation shall assist in such matters from the day following the expiration of the expiration date under Paragraph 1.
